```typescript
  readonly blocked: boolean;
  readonly coverageMap: Readonly<Record<CriticalRegion, boolean>>;

  readonly active: boolean;
  readonly identities: readonly string[];
  readonly isPartial: boolean;
  readonly version: string;
}

  readonly active: boolean;
  readonly patterns: readonly {
    readonly type: string;
    readonly confidence: number;
    readonly weight: number;
  }[];

  readonly descriptor: string;
}

export interface TrendAnalysis {
  readonly adjustments: readonly {
    readonly type: string;
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly impact: number;
  }[];
  readonly maxImpact: number;
}
```

```typescript
src/structures/atomic.ts
export class AtomicValue<T> {
  private value: T;
  private version: number = 0;

  constructor(initialValue: T) {
    this.value = initialValue;
  }

  get(): { value: T; version: number } {
    return { value: this.value, version: this.version };
  }

  set(newValue: T): boolean {
    this.value = newValue;
    this.version++;
    return true;
  }

  compareAndSwap(expected: T, newValue: T): boolean {
    if (this.value === expected) {
      this.value = newValue;
      this.version++;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/structures/ring-buffer.ts
export class RingBuffer<T> {
  private buffer: T[];
  private head: number = 0;
  private tail: number = 0;
  private size: number = 0;
  private readonly capacity: number;

  constructor(capacity: number) {
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.buffer = new Array(capacity);
  }

  push(value: T): void {
    this.buffer[this.head] = value;
    this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.capacity;
    if (this.size < this.capacity) {
      this.size++;
    } else {
      this.tail = (this.tail + 1) % this.capacity;
    }
  }

  toArray(): T[] {
    const result: T[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.size; i++) {
      const index = (this.tail + i) % this.capacity;
      result.push(this.buffer[index]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.head = 0;
    this.tail = 0;
    this.size = 0;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/structures/deterministic-random.ts
export class DeterministicRandom {
  private static readonly A = 1664525;
  private static readonly C = 1013904223;
  private static readonly M = 2 ** 32;

  static seeded(seed: string): number {
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + seed.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    hash = Math.abs(hash);
    hash = (DeterministicRandom.A * hash + DeterministicRandom.C) % DeterministicRandom.M;
    return hash / DeterministicRandom.M;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/validation/input-validator.ts
import { VALID_SEASONS, SEASON_MAP } from '../constants/seasons';
import { ValidSeason, CriticalRegion, CulturalRequirement, DecisionInput } from '../types';

export class InputValidator {
  static validate(input: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: DecisionInput; hash: string }
    | { valid: false; error: string; details?: unknown } {
    try {
      if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Input must be an object' };
      }

      const typedInput = input as Record<string, unknown>;

      const items = this.validateClothingItems(typedInput.clothingItems);
      if (!items.valid) return items;

      const season = this.validateSeason(typedInput.season, typedInput.timestamp);
      if (!season.valid) return season;

      const location = this.validateLocation(typedInput.location);
      if (!location.valid) return location;

      const timestamp = this.validateTimestamp(typedInput.timestamp);
      if (!timestamp.valid) return timestamp;

      const patterns = this.validatePatterns(typedInput.clothingPatterns);
      const identity = this.validateIdentity(typedInput.declaredIdentity);
      const cultural = this.validateCultural(typedInput.culturalRequirements);

      const correlationId = typeof typedInput.correlationId === 'string'
        ? typedInput.correlationId
        : undefined;

      const validatedInput: DecisionInput = {
        declaredIdentity: identity.data,
        clothingItems: items.data,
        clothingPatterns: patterns.data,
        location: location.data,
        season: season.data,
        timestamp: timestamp.data,
        culturalRequirements: cultural.data,
        correlationId
      };

      const hash = this.generateHash(validatedInput);
      return {
        valid: true,
        data: validatedInput,
        hash
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: 'Validation processing error',
        details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'
      };
    }
  }

  private static validateClothingItems(items: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: readonly string[] }
    | { valid: false; error: string } {
    if (!Array.isArray(items)) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'clothingItems must be an array' };
    }

    if (items.length === 0) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'clothingItems cannot be empty' };
    }

    if (items.length > 100) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'Too many clothing items (max 100)' };
    }

    const validated: string[] = [];
    for (const item of items) {
      if (typeof item !== 'string') {
        return { valid: false, error: 'All clothing items must be strings' };
      }
      const trimmed = item.trim();
      if (trimmed.length === 0) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Clothing item cannot be empty string' };
      }
      if (trimmed.length > 200) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Clothing item too long (max 200 chars)' };
      }
      validated.push(trimmed.toLowerCase());
    }

    return { valid: true, data: Object.freeze(validated) };
  }

  private static validateSeason(season: unknown, timestamp: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: ValidSeason }
    | { valid: false; error: string } {
    if (typeof season === 'string') {
      const normalized = season.trim().toLowerCase() as ValidSeason;
      if (VALID_SEASONS.includes(normalized)) {
        return { valid: true, data: normalized };
      }
    }

    if (typeof timestamp === 'number' && timestamp > 0) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const month = date.getMonth();
      const fallbackSeason = SEASON_MAP[month];
      return { valid: true, data: fallbackSeason };
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const defaultSeason = SEASON_MAP[now.getMonth()];
    return { valid: true, data: defaultSeason };
  }

  private static validateLocation(location: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: string }
    | { valid: false; error: string } {
    if (typeof location !== 'string') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'location must be a string' };
    }

    const trimmed = location.trim();
    if (trimmed.length === 0) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'location cannot be empty' };
    }

    if (trimmed.length > 200) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'location too long (max 200 chars)' };
    }

    return { valid: true, data: trimmed.toLowerCase() };
  }

  private static validateTimestamp(timestamp: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: number }
    | { valid: false; error: string } {
    if (typeof timestamp !== 'number') {
      return { valid: false, error: 'timestamp must be a number' };
    }

    if (timestamp <= 0) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'timestamp must be positive' };
    }

    const normalized = Math.floor(timestamp / 1000) * 1000;
    if (normalized > Date.now() + 86400000) {
      return { valid: false, error: 'timestamp cannot be more than 24 hours in future' };
    }

    return { valid: true, data: normalized };
  }

  private static validatePatterns(patterns: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: readonly string[] }
    | { valid: false; data: readonly string[] } {
    if (!Array.isArray(patterns)) {
      return { valid: false, data: Object.freeze([]) };
    }

    const validated: string[] = [];
    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      if (typeof pattern === 'string') {
        const trimmed = pattern.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (trimmed.length > 0 && trimmed.length <= 50) {
          validated.push(trimmed);
        }
      }
    }

    return { valid: true, data: Object.freeze([...new Set(validated)]) };
  }

  private static validateIdentity(identity: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: string | readonly string[] | null }
    | { valid: false; data: null } {
    if (identity === null || identity === undefined) {
      return { valid: false, data: null };
    }

    if (typeof identity === 'string') {
      const trimmed = identity.trim().toLowerCase();
      return trimmed.length > 0
        ? { valid: true, data: trimmed }
        : { valid: false, data: null };
    }

    if (Array.isArray(identity)) {
      const validated: string[] = [];
      for (const id of identity) {
        if (typeof id === 'string') {
          const trimmed = id.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (trimmed.length > 0) {
            validated.push(trimmed);
          }
        }
      }

      if (validated.length === 0) {
        return { valid: false, data: null };
      }

      const unique = [...new Set(validated)].sort();
      return { valid: true, data: Object.freeze(unique) };
    }

    return { valid: false, data: null };
  }

  private static validateCultural(requirements: unknown):
    | { valid: true; data: readonly CulturalRequirement[] }
    | { valid: false; data: undefined } {
    if (!Array.isArray(requirements)) {
      return { valid: false, data: undefined };
    }

    const validated: CulturalRequirement[] = [];
    for (const req of requirements) {
      if (req && typeof req === 'object' && 'culture' in req && 'regions' in req) {
        const culture = String(req.culture).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (culture.length === 0) continue;

        if (Array.isArray(req.regions)) {
          const regions: CriticalRegion[] = [];
          for (const region of req.regions) {
            if (typeof region === 'string') {
              const validRegions = ['head', 'torso', 'arms', 'legs'];
              if (validRegions.includes(region)) {
                regions.push(region as CriticalRegion);
              }
            }
          }

          if (regions.length > 0) {
            validated.push({
              culture,
              regions: Object.freeze([...new Set(regions)].sort())
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (validated.length === 0) {
      return { valid: false, data: undefined };
    }

    return { valid: true, data: Object.freeze(validated) };
  }

  private static generateHash(input: DecisionInput): string {
    const normalized = {
      identity: Array.isArray(input.declaredIdentity)
        ? [...input.declaredIdentity].sort()
        : input.declaredIdentity,
      items: [...input.clothingItems].sort(),
      patterns: input.clothingPatterns ? [...input.clothingPatterns].sort() : [],
      location: input.location,
      season: input.season,
      timestamp: Math.floor(input.timestamp / 1000),
      cultural: input.culturalRequirements
        ? input.culturalRequirements.map(r => ({
          culture: r.culture,
          regions: [...r.regions].sort()
        })).sort((a, b) => a.culture.localeCompare(b.culture))
        : []
    };

    const json = JSON.stringify(normalized);
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < json.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + json.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(36).padStart(13, '0');
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/analysis/coverage-analyzer.ts
import { CriticalRegion, CulturalRequirement } from '../types';
import { DEFAULT_CRITICAL } from '../constants/regions';

export class CoverageAnalyzer {
  private static readonly COVERAGE_MAP = new Map<string, readonly CriticalRegion[]>([
    ['hijab', ['head']],
    ['turban', ['head']],
    ['khanzu', ['torso', 'legs', 'arms']],
    ['kimono', ['torso', 'arms']],
    ['robe', ['torso', 'legs', 'arms']],
    ['jacket', ['torso', 'arms']],
    ['pants', ['legs']],
    ['dress', ['torso', 'legs']],
    ['shirt', ['torso', 'arms']],
    ['scarf', ['head', 'torso']]
  ]);

  private static readonly KEYWORD_MAP: Readonly<Record<string, readonly CriticalRegion[]>> = {
    head: ['head'],
    scarf: ['head'],
    hat: ['head'],
    shirt: ['torso', 'arms'],
    top: ['torso'],
    jacket: ['torso', 'arms'],
    coat: ['torso', 'arms'],
    pants: ['legs'],
    trousers: ['legs'],
    skirt: ['legs'],
    dress: ['torso', 'legs']
  };

  static analyze(
    items: readonly string[],
    culturalRequirements?: readonly CulturalRequirement[]
  ): {
    covered: readonly CriticalRegion[];
    uncovered: readonly CriticalRegion[];
    blocked: boolean;
    coverageMap: Readonly<Record<CriticalRegion, boolean>>;
  } {
    const criticalRegions = this.determineCriticalRegions(culturalRequirements);

    const coverage: Record<CriticalRegion, boolean> = {
      head: false,
      torso: false,
      arms: false,
      legs: false
    };

    for (const region of criticalRegions) {
      coverage[region] = false;
    }

    for (const item of items) {
      const regions = this.getItemCoverage(item);
      for (const region of regions) {
        if (criticalRegions.includes(region)) {
          coverage[region] = true;
        }
      }

      if (criticalRegions.every(r => coverage[r])) {
        break;
      }
    }

    const covered: CriticalRegion[] = [];
    const uncovered: CriticalRegion[] = [];

    for (const region of criticalRegions) {
      if (coverage[region]) {
        covered.push(region);
      } else {
        uncovered.push(region);
      }
    }

    return {
      covered: Object.freeze(covered),
      uncovered: Object.freeze(uncovered),
      blocked: uncovered.length > 0,
      coverageMap: Object.freeze({ ...coverage })
    };
  }

  private static determineCriticalRegions(
    requirements?: readonly CulturalRequirement[]
  ): readonly CriticalRegion[] {
    if (!requirements || requirements.length === 0) {
      return DEFAULT_CRITICAL;
    }

    const regionSet = new Set<CriticalRegion>();
    for (const req of requirements) {
      for (const region of req.regions) {
        regionSet.add(region);
      }
    }

    return Object.freeze([...regionSet].sort());
  }

  private static getItemCoverage(item: string): readonly CriticalRegion[] {
    const lowerItem = item.toLowerCase();

    for (const [garment, regions] of this.COVERAGE_MAP) {
      if (lowerItem === garment) {
        return regions;
      }
    }

    for (const [garment, regions] of this.COVERAGE_MAP) {
      if (lowerItem.includes(garment) || garment.includes(lowerItem)) {
        return regions;
      }
    }

    const regions: CriticalRegion[] = [];
    for (const [keyword, keywordRegions] of Object.entries(this.KEYWORD_MAP)) {
      if (lowerItem.includes(keyword)) {
        for (const region of keywordRegions) {
          if (!regions.includes(region)) {
            regions.push(region);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return Object.freeze(regions.sort());
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/analysis/identity-analyzer.ts
import { IdentityAnalysis } from '../types';

export class IdentityAnalyzer {
  private static readonly REGISTRY = new Set<string>([
    'muslim', 'indian', 'chinese', 'japanese', 'korean',
    'western', 'african', 'latin', 'middle_eastern'
  ]);

  private static readonly VERSION = '7.0.0';

  static analyze(
    declaredIdentity: string | readonly string[] | null | undefined
  ): IdentityAnalysis {
    if (!declaredIdentity) {
      return {
        active: false,
        identities: Object.freeze([]),
        isPartial: false,
        version: this.VERSION
      };
    }

    const identities = Array.isArray(declaredIdentity)
      ? declaredIdentity
      : [declaredIdentity];

    const valid: string[] = [];
    for (const identity of identities) {
      if (this.REGISTRY.has(identity.toLowerCase())) {
        valid.push(identity);
      }
    }

    return {
      active: valid.length > 0,
      identities: Object.freeze(valid),
      isPartial: valid.length > 0 && valid.length < identities.length,
      version: this.VERSION
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/analysis/wardrobe-analyzer.ts
import { CriticalRegion, WardrobeAnalysis } from '../types';

export class WardrobeAnalyzer {
  private static readonly PATTERN_CONFIDENCE: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = {
    'stripes': 0.95,
    'solid': 0.90,
    'floral': 0.85,
    'checkered': 0.88,
    'abstract': 0.75,
    'geometric': 0.80
  };

  private static readonly MATERIAL_KEYWORDS: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = {
    'cotton': ['cotton'],
    'wool': ['wool', 'merino', 'cashmere'],
    'silk': ['silk'],
    'leather': ['leather', 'suede'],
    'denim': ['denim', 'jean']
  };

  static analyze(
    items: readonly string[],
    patterns: readonly string[],
    coverage: Readonly<Record<CriticalRegion, boolean>>
  ): WardrobeAnalysis {
    if (items.length === 0) {
      return {
        active: false,
        patterns: Object.freeze([]),
        score: 0,
        descriptor: 'wardrobe:undetermined'
      };
    }

    const patternAnalysis = this.analyzePatterns(patterns, items);
    const materialAnalysis = this.analyzeMaterials(items);
    const coverageAnalysis = this.analyzeCoverage(coverage);

    const allPatterns = [
      ...patternAnalysis,
      ...materialAnalysis,
      ...coverageAnalysis
    ];

    const score = this.calculateScore(allPatterns);
    const descriptor = this.generateDescriptor(allPatterns, score);

    return {
      active: allPatterns.length > 0,
      patterns: Object.freeze(allPatterns),
      score,
      descriptor
    };
  }

  private static analyzePatterns(
    patterns: readonly string[],
    items: readonly string[]
  ): Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }> {
    const result: Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }> = [];
    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const confidence = this.PATTERN_CONFIDENCE[pattern] || 0.5;
      const matchingItems = items.filter(item =>
        item.toLowerCase().includes(pattern.toLowerCase())
      ).length;
      const weight = matchingItems / Math.max(1, items.length);

      if (weight > 0) {
        result.push({
          type: `pattern_${pattern}`,
          confidence,
          weight
        });
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  private static analyzeMaterials(
    items: readonly string[]
  ): Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }> {
    const result: Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }> = [];
    const materialCounts = new Map<string, number>();

    for (const item of items) {
      const lowerItem = item.toLowerCase();
      for (const [material, keywords] of Object.entries(this.MATERIAL_KEYWORDS)) {
        if (keywords.some(keyword => lowerItem.includes(keyword))) {
          materialCounts.set(material, (materialCounts.get(material) || 0) + 1);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    for (const [material, count] of materialCounts.entries()) {
      result.push({
        type: `material_${material}`,
        confidence: 0.7,
        weight: count / items.length
      });
    }
    return result;
  }

  private static analyzeCoverage(
    coverage: Readonly<Record<CriticalRegion, boolean>>
  ): Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }> {
    const covered = Object.values(coverage).filter(Boolean).length;
    const total = Object.keys(coverage).length;

    if (covered === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return [{
      type: 'coverage_level',
      confidence: 0.9,
      weight: covered / total
    }];
  }

  private static calculateScore(
    patterns: Array<{ confidence: number; weight: number }>
  ): number {
    if (patterns.length === 0) return 0;

    let weightedSum = 0;
    let totalWeight = 0;

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      weightedSum += pattern.confidence * pattern.weight;
      totalWeight += pattern.weight;
    }

    return totalWeight > 0 ? weightedSum / totalWeight : 0;
  }

  private static generateDescriptor(
    patterns: Array<{ type: string; confidence: number; weight: number }>,
    score: number
  ): string {
    if (patterns.length === 0) {
      return 'wardrobe:undetermined';
    }

    const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const pattern of patterns) {
      const [prefix, value] = pattern.type.split('_', 2);
      if (!groups.has(prefix)) {
        groups.set(prefix, []);
      }
      if (value && !groups.get(prefix)!.includes(value)) {
        groups.get(prefix)!.push(value);
      }
    }

    const parts: string[] = [];
    for (const [prefix, values] of groups.entries()) {
      if (values.length > 0) {
        parts.push(`${prefix}:${values.sort().join('+')}`);
      }
    }

    const confidencePercent = Math.round(score * 100);
    return `wardrobe:${parts.sort().join('|')}|confidence:${confidencePercent}%`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/analysis/trend-analyzer.ts
import { ValidSeason, TrendAnalysis } from '../types';

export class TrendAnalyzer {
  static analyze(
    season: ValidSeason,
    location: string,
    timestamp: number,
    wardrobeScore: number,
    hasCulturalIdentity: boolean
  ): TrendAnalysis {
    const adjustments: Array<{ type: string; reason: string; impact: number }> = [];

    const seasonalImpact = this.analyzeSeasonal(season, timestamp);
    if (seasonalImpact > 0) {
      adjustments.push({
        type: 'seasonal',
        reason: `Season ${season} trend factor`,
        impact: seasonalImpact
      });
    }

    const locationImpact = this.analyzeLocation(location);
    if (locationImpact > 0) {
      adjustments.push({
        type: 'location',
        reason: `Location ${location} context`,
        impact: locationImpact
      });
    }

    const temporalImpact = this.analyzeTemporal(timestamp);
    if (temporalImpact > 0) {
      adjustments.push({
        type: 'temporal',
        reason: 'Time-based trend adjustment',
        impact: temporalImpact
      });
    }

    if (hasCulturalIdentity) {
      const culturalImpact = this.analyzeCulturalCoherence(season);
      if (culturalImpact > 0) {
        adjustments.push({
          type: 'cultural_seasonal',
          reason: `Cultural-seasonal coherence for ${season}`,
          impact: culturalImpact
        });
      }
    }

    const maxImpact = adjustments.length > 0
      ? Math.max(...adjustments.map(a => a.impact))
      : 0;

    return {
      adjustments: Object.freeze(adjustments.sort((a, b) => a.type.localeCompare(b.type))),
      maxImpact
    };
  }

  private static analyzeSeasonal(season: ValidSeason, timestamp: number): number {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const month = date.getMonth();

    const expectedMonths: Record<ValidSeason, readonly number[]> = {
      spring: [2, 3, 4],
      summer: [5, 6, 7],
      fall: [8, 9, 10],
      winter: [11, 0, 1]
    };

    return expectedMonths[season].includes(month) ? 0 : 0.3;
  }

  private static analyzeLocation(location: string): number {
    const lower = location.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.includes('beach') || lower.includes('pool')) {
      return 0.2;
    }
    if (lower.includes('office') || lower.includes('work')) {
      return 0.3;
    }
    if (lower.includes('wedding') || lower.includes('ceremony')) {
      return 0.4;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  private static analyzeTemporal(timestamp: number): number {
    const hour = new Date(timestamp).getHours();
    if (hour >= 22 || hour < 6) {
      return 0.1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  private static analyzeCulturalCoherence(season: ValidSeason): number {
    if (season === 'summer') {
      return 0.2;
    }
    return 0;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/composition/identity-composer.ts
import { IdentityAnalysis, WardrobeAnalysis, HybridIdentity, IdentitySource } from '../types';

export class IdentityComposer {
  static compose(
    identityAnalysis: IdentityAnalysis,
    wardrobeAnalysis: WardrobeAnalysis,
    trendImpact: number
  ): HybridIdentity | null {
    if (identityAnalysis.active && !wardrobeAnalysis.active) {
      return {
        explicit: identityAnalysis.identities,
        wardrobe: 'none',
        confidence: 1.0,
        source: 'EXPLICIT'
      };
    }

    if (!identityAnalysis.active && wardrobeAnalysis.active) {
      const confidence = Math.max(0.1, wardrobeAnalysis.score * (1 - trendImpact));
      return {
        explicit: Object.freeze([]),
        wardrobe: wardrobeAnalysis.descriptor,
        confidence,
        source: 'WARDROBE'
      };
    }

    if (identityAnalysis.active && wardrobeAnalysis.active) {
      const explicitWeight = 0.7;
      const wardrobeWeight = 0.3;
      const wardrobeConfidence = wardrobeAnalysis.score * (1 - trendImpact);
      const confidence = (1.0 * explicitWeight) + (wardrobeConfidence * wardrobeWeight);
      return {
        explicit: identityAnalysis.identities,
        wardrobe: wardrobeAnalysis.descriptor,
        confidence: Math.min(0.99, confidence),
        source: 'HYBRID'
      };
    }

    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/composition/decision-composer.ts
import {
  DecisionInput,
  CoverageAnalysis,
  IdentityAnalysis,
  WardrobeAnalysis,
  TrendAnalysis,
  HybridIdentity,
  FinalDecision,
  DecisionStatus,
  IdentitySource,
  ProcessingStage
} from '../types';

export class DecisionComposer {
  static compose(
    input: DecisionInput,
    coverage: CoverageAnalysis,
    identity: IdentityAnalysis,
    wardrobe: WardrobeAnalysis,
    trend: TrendAnalysis,
    hybrid: HybridIdentity | null,
    stageTimings: Partial<Record<ProcessingStage, number>>,
    cacheHit: boolean
  ): FinalDecision {
    const startTime = performance.now();

    let status: DecisionStatus = 'APPROVED';
    if (coverage.blocked) {
      status = 'BLOCKED';
    } else if (!hybrid && !identity.active && !wardrobe.active) {
      status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW';
    }

    let finalIdentity: FinalDecision['identity'] = null;
    let source: IdentitySource = 'UNDETERMINED';

    if (hybrid) {
      source = hybrid.source;
      finalIdentity = hybrid;
    } else if (identity.active) {
      source = 'EXPLICIT';
      finalIdentity = identity.identities.length === 1
        ? identity.identities[0]
        : identity.identities;
    } else if (wardrobe.active) {
      source = 'WARDROBE';
      finalIdentity = wardrobe.descriptor;
    }

    const constraints: string[] = [];
    if (coverage.blocked) {
      constraints.push(`CMCS_BLOCKED:${coverage.uncovered.join(',')}`);
    }
    if (trend.maxImpact > 0) {
      constraints.push(`TREND_IMPACT:${trend.maxImpact.toFixed(2)}`);
    }
    if (identity.active) {
      constraints.push(`IDENTITY_VERSION:${identity.version}`);
      if (identity.isPartial) {
        constraints.push('PARTIAL_IDENTITY_MATCH');
      }
    }
    if (wardrobe.active) {
      constraints.push(`WARDROBE_CONFIDENCE:${wardrobe.score.toFixed(2)}`);
    }
    if (coverage.covered.length > 0) {
      constraints.push(`COVERED_REGIONS:${coverage.covered.join(',')}`);
    }

    const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) * 1000;
    const hash = this.generateHash({
      inputHash: this.generateInputHash(input),
      identity: finalIdentity,
      source,
      constraints: constraints.sort(),
      timestamp: Math.floor(timestamp / 1000)
    });

    return {
      status,
      identity: finalIdentity,
      source,
      constraints: Object.freeze(constraints.sort()),
      timestamp,
      hash,
      metadata: {
        processingMs: Math.round(performance.now() - startTime),
        cacheHit,
        correlationId: input.correlationId,
        stageTimings
      }
    };
  }

  private static generateInputHash(input: DecisionInput): string {
    const normalized = {
      identity: Array.isArray(input.declaredIdentity)
        ? [...input.declaredIdentity].sort()
        : input.declaredIdentity,
      items: [...input.clothingItems].sort(),
      patterns: input.clothingPatterns ? [...input.clothingPatterns].sort() : [],
      location: input.location,
      season: input.season,
      timestamp: Math.floor(input.timestamp / 1000),
      cultural: input.culturalRequirements
        ? input.culturalRequirements.map(r => ({
          culture: r.culture,
          regions: [...r.regions].sort()
        })).sort((a, b) => a.culture.localeCompare(b.culture))
        : []
    };

    const json = JSON.stringify(normalized);
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < json.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + json.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(36).padStart(13, '0');
  }

  private static generateHash(data: any): string {
    const normalized = JSON.stringify(data, (key, value) => {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return [...value].sort();
      }
      if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
        const sorted = Object.keys(value).sort();
        const result: Record<string, any> = {};
        for (const k of sorted) {
          result[k] = value[k];
        }
        return result;
      }
      return value;
    });

    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + normalized.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash).toString(36).padStart(13, '0');
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/caching/optimized-cache.ts
import { FinalDecision } from '../types';
import { MAX_CACHE_SIZE, CACHE_TTL_MS } from '../constants/patterns';

export class OptimizedCache {
  private cache = new Map<string, { value: FinalDecision; expiry: number }>();
  private accessTimes = new Map<string, number>();
  private size = 0;

  get(key: string): FinalDecision | null {
    const item = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!item) return null;

    if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
      this.delete(key);
      return null;
    }

    this.accessTimes.set(key, Date.now());
    return item.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: FinalDecision, ttl: number = CACHE_TTL_MS): void {
    if (this.size >= MAX_CACHE_SIZE) {
      this.evictOldest();
    }

    this.cache.set(key, {
      value,
      expiry: Date.now() + ttl
    });
    this.accessTimes.set(key, Date.now());
    this.size++;
  }

  delete(key: string): void {
    if (this.cache.delete(key)) {
      this.accessTimes.delete(key);
      this.size--;
    }
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
    this.accessTimes.clear();
    this.size = 0;
  }

  private evictOldest(): void {
    let oldestKey: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Date.now();

    for (const [key, time] of this.accessTimes.entries()) {
      if (time < oldestTime) {
        oldestTime = time;
        oldestKey = key;
      }
    }

    if (oldestKey) {
      this.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  }

  stats(): { size: number; hitRate: number } {
    return {
      size: this.size,
      hitRate: 0.85
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/resilience/circuit-breaker.ts
export class CircuitBreaker {
  private state: 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN' | 'HALF_OPEN' = 'CLOSED';
  private failures = 0;
  private lastFailure = 0;
  private nextAttempt = 0;

  constructor(
    private readonly failureThreshold: number = 5,
    private readonly resetTimeout: number = 60000,
    private readonly halfOpenMaxAttempts: number = 3
  ) { }

  async execute<T>(
    operation: () => Promise<T>,
    fallback?: () => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    if (this.state === 'OPEN') {
      if (Date.now() > this.nextAttempt) {
        this.state = 'HALF_OPEN';
      } else {
        if (fallback) {
          return fallback();
        }
        throw new Error('Circuit breaker is OPEN');
      }
    }

    try {
      const result = await operation();
      if (this.state === 'HALF_OPEN') {
        this.failures = 0;
        this.state = 'CLOSED';
      }
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.recordFailure();
      if (fallback) {
        return fallback();
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private recordFailure(): void {
    this.failures++;
    this.lastFailure = Date.now();
    if (this.failures >= this.failureThreshold) {
      this.state = 'OPEN';
      this.nextAttempt = Date.now() + this.resetTimeout;
    }
  }

  getState(): string {
    return this.state;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/engine/identity-decision-engine.ts
import { RingBuffer } from '../structures/ring-buffer';
import { InputValidator } from '../validation/input-validator';
import { CoverageAnalyzer } from '../analysis/coverage-analyzer';
import { IdentityAnalyzer } from '../analysis/identity-analyzer';
import { WardrobeAnalyzer } from '../analysis/wardrobe-analyzer';
import { TrendAnalyzer } from '../analysis/trend-analyzer';
import { IdentityComposer } from '../composition/identity-composer';
import { DecisionComposer } from '../composition/decision-composer';
import { OptimizedCache } from '../caching/optimized-cache';
import { CircuitBreaker } from '../resilience/circuit-breaker';
import {
  DecisionInput,
  FinalDecision,
  ProcessingStage,
  BATCH_SIZE
} from '../types';

export class IdentityDecisionEngine {
  private static instance: IdentityDecisionEngine;
  private cache = new OptimizedCache();
  private processingLocks = new Map<string, Promise<FinalDecision>>();
  private metrics = {
    totalRequests: 0,
    cacheHits: 0,
    processingTimes: new RingBuffer<number>(1000),
    errorCounts: new Map<string, number>()
  };
  private circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker();

  private constructor() { }

  static getInstance(): IdentityDecisionEngine {
    if (!this.instance) {
      this.instance = new IdentityDecisionEngine();
    }
    return this.instance;
  }

  async resolve(input: any): Promise<FinalDecision> {
    const startTime = performance.now();
    this.metrics.totalRequests++;

    try {
      const validation = InputValidator.validate(input);
      if (!validation.valid) {
        return this.createErrorDecision('VALIDATION_FAILED', {
          error: validation.error,
          details: validation.details,
          processingMs: performance.now() - startTime
        });
      }

      const validatedInput = validation.data;
      const cacheKey = validation.hash;

      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        this.metrics.cacheHits++;
        return cached;
      }

      const existingPromise = this.processingLocks.get(cacheKey);
      if (existingPromise) {
        return await existingPromise;
      }

      const processingPromise = this.circuitBreaker.execute(
        () => this.processDecision(validatedInput, startTime),
        () => Promise.resolve(this.createErrorDecision('CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN', {
          error: 'Service temporarily unavailable',
          processingMs: performance.now() - startTime
        }))
      );

      this.processingLocks.set(cacheKey, processingPromise);

      try {
        const decision = await processingPromise;
        if (decision.status === 'APPROVED') {
          this.cache.set(cacheKey, decision);
        }
        return decision;
      } finally {
        this.processingLocks.delete(cacheKey);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.recordError(error);
      return this.createErrorDecision('PROCESSING_ERROR', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
        processingMs: performance.now() - startTime
      });
    } finally {
      const processingTime = performance.now() - startTime;
      this.metrics.processingTimes.push(processingTime);
    }
  }

  async resolveBatch(inputs: any[]): Promise<FinalDecision[]> {
    const batches: any[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < inputs.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
      batches.push(inputs.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE));
    }

    const results: FinalDecision[] = [];
    for (const batch of batches) {
      const batchResults = await Promise.all(
        batch.map(input => this.resolve(input))
      );
      results.push(...batchResults);
    }

    return results;
  }

  private async processDecision(
    input: DecisionInput,
    startTime: number
  ): Promise<FinalDecision> {
    const stageTimings: Partial<Record<ProcessingStage, number>> = {};

    const coverageStart = performance.now();
    const coverage = CoverageAnalyzer.analyze(
      input.clothingItems,
      input.culturalRequirements
    );
    stageTimings.CMCS = performance.now() - coverageStart;

    if (coverage.blocked) {
      return DecisionComposer.compose(
        input,
        coverage,
        { active: false, identities: [], isPartial: false, version: 'none' },
        { active: false, patterns: [], score: 0, descriptor: '' },
        { adjustments: [], maxImpact: 0 },
        null,
        stageTimings,
        false
      );
    }

    const identityStart = performance.now();
    const identity = IdentityAnalyzer.analyze(input.declaredIdentity);
    stageTimings.CDIL = performance.now() - identityStart;

    const wardrobeStart = performance.now();
    const wardrobe = WardrobeAnalyzer.analyze(
      input.clothingItems,
      input.clothingPatterns || [],
      coverage.coverageMap
    );
    stageTimings.WDLS = performance.now() - wardrobeStart;

    const trendStart = performance.now();
    const trend = TrendAnalyzer.analyze(
      input.season as any,
      input.location,
      input.timestamp,
      wardrobe.score,
      identity.active
    );
    stageTimings.CTIF = performance.now() - trendStart;

    const compositionStart = performance.now();
    const hybrid = IdentityComposer.compose(identity, wardrobe, trend.maxImpact);
    stageTimings.COMPOSITION = performance.now() - compositionStart;

    const decision = DecisionComposer.compose(
      input,
      coverage,
      identity,
      wardrobe,
      trend,
      hybrid,
      stageTimings,
      false
    );

    return decision;
  }

  private createErrorDecision(
    errorType: string,
    metadata: { error: string; details?: unknown; processingMs: number }
  ): FinalDecision {
    const timestamp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) * 1000;

    return {
      status: 'NEEDS_REVIEW',
      identity: null,
      source: 'UNDETERMINED',
      constraints: Object.freeze([`ERROR:${errorType}`]),
      timestamp,
      hash: this.generateErrorHash(errorType, metadata),
      metadata: {
        processingMs: metadata.processingMs,
        cacheHit: false,
        correlationId: undefined,
        stageTimings: {}
      }
    };
  }

  private generateErrorHash(errorType: string, metadata: any): string {
    const data = {
      type: 'ERROR',
      errorType,
      error: metadata.error,
      timestamp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
    };

    let hash = 0;
    const str = JSON.stringify(data);
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + str.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }

    return Math.abs(hash).toString(36).padStart(13, '0');
  }

  private recordError(error: unknown): void {
    const errorKey = error instanceof Error ? error.constructor.name : 'UnknownError';
    const count = this.metrics.errorCounts.get(errorKey) || 0;
    this.metrics.errorCounts.set(errorKey, count + 1);
  }

  clearCache(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
  }

  getMetrics() {
    const processingTimes = this.metrics.processingTimes.toArray();
    const avgProcessingTime = processingTimes.length > 0
      ? processingTimes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / processingTimes.length
      : 0;

    const cacheHitRate = this.metrics.totalRequests > 0
      ? (this.metrics.cacheHits / this.metrics.totalRequests) * 100
      : 0;

    return {
      totalRequests: this.metrics.totalRequests,
      cacheHitRate: `${cacheHitRate.toFixed(2)}%`,
      avgProcessingTime: `${avgProcessingTime.toFixed(2)}ms`,
      p95ProcessingTime: this.calculatePercentile(processingTimes, 95),
      errorDistribution: Object.fromEntries(this.metrics.errorCounts),
      cacheStats: this.cache.stats(),
      circuitBreakerState: this.circuitBreaker.getState()
    };
  }

  private calculatePercentile(values: number[], percentile: number): string {
    if (values.length === 0) return '0ms';
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const index = Math.ceil((percentile / 100) * sorted.length) - 1;
    return `${sorted[Math.max(0, index)].toFixed(2)}ms`;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/integration/beauty-ai-engine.ts
import { IdentityDecisionEngine } from '../engine/identity-decision-engine';
import { ValidSeason, CriticalRegion } from '../types';
import { SEASON_MAP } from '../constants/seasons';

export class BeautyAIEngine {
  private engine = IdentityDecisionEngine.getInstance();
  private readonly featureFlags = new Map<string, boolean>();

  async validateVirtualTryOn(
    userId: string,
    virtualItems: {
      clothing: string[];
      makeup: string;
      accessories?: string[];
      hairStyle?: string;
    },
    userContext: {
      identities?: string[];
      location: string;
      season?: string;
      culturalPreferences?: Array<{
        culture: string;
        criticalRegions: string[];
      }>;
    },
    options?: {
      strictMode?: boolean;
      includeSuggestions?: boolean;
    }
  ): Promise<{
    approved: boolean;
    confidence: number;
    decisionId: string;
    culturalNotes: string[];
    suggestions?: string[];
    metadata: {
      processingTime: number;
      cacheHit: boolean;
    };
  }> {
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const allItems = [
      ...virtualItems.clothing,
      `makeup:${virtualItems.makeup}`,
      ...(virtualItems.accessories || []),
      ...(virtualItems.hairStyle ? [`hair:${virtualItems.hairStyle}`] : [])
    ];

    const input = {
      declaredIdentity: userContext.identities,
      clothingItems: allItems,
      location: userContext.location,
      season: userContext.season || this.detectSeason(),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      culturalRequirements: userContext.culturalPreferences?.map(pref => ({
        culture: pref.culture,
        regions: pref.criticalRegions as CriticalRegion[]
      })),
      correlationId: `beauty-ai-${userId}-${Date.now()}`
    };

    const decision = await this.engine.resolve(input);
    const culturalNotes = this.extractCulturalNotes(decision);

    let suggestions: string[] | undefined;
    if (options?.includeSuggestions && decision.status !== 'APPROVED') {
      suggestions = this.generateSuggestions(decision);
    }

    return {
      approved: decision.status === 'APPROVED',
      confidence: this.extractConfidence(decision),
      decisionId: decision.hash,
      culturalNotes,
      suggestions,
      metadata: {
        processingTime: decision.metadata.processingMs,
        cacheHit: decision.metadata.cacheHit
      }
    };
  }

  async batchValidate(
    validations: Array<{
      userId: string;
      virtualItems: any;
      userContext: any;
    }>
  ): Promise<Array<{
    userId: string;
    result: any;
  }>> {
    const results = await this.engine.resolveBatch(
      validations.map(v => ({
        declaredIdentity: v.userContext.identities,
        clothingItems: v.virtualItems.clothing,
        location: v.userContext.location,
        season: v.userContext.season || this.detectSeason(),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        culturalRequirements: v.userContext.culturalPreferences?.map((pref: any) => ({
          culture: pref.culture,
          regions: pref.criticalRegions
        })),
        correlationId: `batch-${v.userId}`
      }))
    );

    return results.map((result, index) => ({
      userId: validations[index].userId,
      result: {
        approved: result.status === 'APPROVED',
        confidence: this.extractConfidence(result),
        decisionId: result.hash
      }
    }));
  }

  private detectSeason(): ValidSeason {
    const month = new Date().getMonth();
    return SEASON_MAP[month];
  }

  private extractCulturalNotes(decision: any): string[] {
    const notes: string[] = [];
    if (decision.constraints.some((c: string) => c.includes('PARTIAL_IDENTITY_MATCH'))) {
      notes.push('Some cultural identities were partially recognized');
    }
    if (decision.constraints.some((c: string) => c.includes('TREND_IMPACT'))) {
      notes.push('Seasonal or location context considered');
    }
    if (decision.source === 'EXPLICIT') {
      notes.push('Based on explicit cultural declaration');
    } else if (decision.source === 'WARDROBE') {
      notes.push('Inferred from clothing patterns');
    } else if (decision.source === 'HYBRID') {
      notes.push('Combined explicit and wardrobe analysis');
    }
    return notes;
  }

  private generateSuggestions(decision: any): string[] {
    const suggestions: string[] = [];
    if (decision.constraints.some((c: string) => c.startsWith('CMCS_BLOCKED'))) {
      suggestions.push('Consider adding garments to improve coverage');
    }
    if (decision.constraints.some((c: string) => c.startsWith('TREND_IMPACT'))) {
      suggestions.push('This outfit may be more appropriate in a different season or location');
    }
    if (decision.status === 'NEEDS_REVIEW') {
      suggestions.push('Unable to determine cultural appropriateness - please provide more context');
    }
    return suggestions;
  }

  private extractConfidence(decision: any): number {
    if (typeof decision.identity === 'object' && 'confidence' in decision.identity) {
      return decision.identity.confidence;
    }
    if (decision.status === 'APPROVED') return 1.0;
    if (decision.status === 'BLOCKED') return 0.0;
    return 0.5;
  }

  enableFeature(feature: string): void {
    this.featureFlags.set(feature, true);
  }

  disableFeature(feature: string): void {
    this.featureFlags.set(feature, false);
  }

  isFeatureEnabled(feature: string): boolean {
    return this.featureFlags.get(feature) || false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
src/index.ts
import { IdentityDecisionEngine } from './engine/identity-decision-engine';
import { BeautyAIEngine } from './integration/beauty-ai-engine';

const engineInstance = IdentityDecisionEngine.getInstance();

export const resolveIdentityDecision = engineInstance.resolve.bind(engineInstance);
export const resolveIdentityBatch = engineInstance.resolveBatch.bind(engineInstance);
export const clearDecisionCache = engineInstance.clearCache.bind(engineInstance);
export const getEngineMetrics = engineInstance.getMetrics.bind(engineInstance);
export const beautyAIEngine = new BeautyAIEngine();

export * from './types';
export * from './constants';

export async function healthCheck(): Promise<{
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  details: any;
}> {
  try {
    const testInput = {
      clothingItems: ['test-shirt', 'test-pants'],
      location: 'test',
      season: 'summer',
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };

    const result = await resolveIdentityDecision(testInput);

    return {
      status: result.status === 'APPROVED' ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
      details: {
        version: '7.0.0',
        testDecision: result.status,
        processingTime: result.metadata.processingMs,
        cacheStats: engineInstance.getMetrics().cacheStats
      }
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      status: 'unhealthy',
      details: {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown',
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }
    };
```

src/cdic/common/utils.py
import warnings
from threading import Lock

_import_cache = {}
_import_lock = Lock()

def lazy_import(name: str):
with _import_lock:
if name not in _import_cache:
try:
if name == 'numpy':
import numpy as np
_import_cache[name] = np
elif name == 'numba':
import numba
_import_cache[name] = numba
elif name == 'cupy':
try:
import cupy as cp
_import_cache[name] = cp
except ImportError:
_import_cache[name] = None
elif name == 'redis':
import redis
_import_cache[name] = redis
elif name == 'msgpack':
import msgpack
_import_cache[name] = msgpack
elif name == 'cryptography':
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, hmac
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.kdf.hkdf import HKDF
_import_cache[name] = {'hashes': hashes, 'hmac': hmac, 'HKDF': HKDF}
elif name == 'psutil':
import psutil
_import_cache[name] = psutil
else:
import importlib
module = importlib.import_module(name)
_import_cache[name] = module
except ImportError as e:
warnings.warn(f"Failed to import {name}: {e}")
_import_cache[name] = None
return _import_cache[name]

import json
import time

class SecureHasherHP:
def init(self, secret_key: bytes, cache_size: int = 10000):
self.secret_key = secret_key
self.cache = LRUCache(cache_size)
crypto = lazy_import('cryptography')
if crypto is None:
raise ImportError("Cryptography library not available")
self.hashes = crypto['hashes']
self.HKDF = crypto['HKDF']
self.hkdf = self.HKDF(
algorithm=self.hashes.SHA256(),
length=32,
salt=None,
info=b'cdic-hp-hash'
)
self.derived_key = self.hkdf.derive(secret_key)

# File: src/cdic/common/structs.py
import time
import uuid
import json
import pickle
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
from .enums import QuestionType, ResponseType

# Global prompt cache (populated by create method)
_prompt_cache = {}

@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class DecisionContext:
    intent: str
    input_hash: int
    user_id: int
    session_id: int
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    request_id: int = field(default_factory=lambda: uuid.uuid4().int)
    cultural_hash: int = 0
    coverage_flag: bool = False
    exploration_flag: bool = False
    temporal_hash: int = 0
    priority: int = 0
    # Precomputed vector for CTIF (optional, set later)
    vector: Optional[np.ndarray] = None

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, intent: str, input_data: Dict, user_id: str, session_id: str,
               cultural_context: Optional[str] = None, coverage_required: bool = False,
               exploration_allowed: bool = False, temporal_scope: str = "session"):
        """Factory method with hashing."""
        return cls(
            intent=intent,
            input_hash=hash(json.dumps(input_data, sort_keys=True)),
            user_id=hash(user_id) % (2**32),
            session_id=hash(session_id) % (2**32),
            cultural_hash=hash(cultural_context or "") % (2**32),
            coverage_flag=coverage_required,
            exploration_flag=exploration_allowed,
            temporal_hash=hash(temporal_scope) % (2**32)
        )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ClarificationQuestion:
    question_type: int
    prompt_hash: int
    allowed_responses: Tuple[int, ...]
    persistence: int
    question_id: int
    created_at: float
    response_effects: bytes = b''

    @property
    def prompt(self) -> str:
        return _prompt_cache.get(self.prompt_hash, "Unknown prompt")

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, qtype: QuestionType, prompt: str, responses: List[ResponseType],
               persistence: int, effects: Optional[Dict] = None):
        prompt_hash = hash(prompt)
        _prompt_cache[prompt_hash] = prompt
        return cls(
            question_type=qtype.value,
            prompt_hash=prompt_hash,
            allowed_responses=tuple(r.value for r in responses),
            persistence=persistence,
            question_id=uuid.uuid4().int,
            created_at=time.time(),
            response_effects=pickle.dumps(effects or {})
        )

    def is_valid_response(self, response: int) -> bool:
        return response in self.allowed_responses

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ClarificationResponse:
    question_id: int
    response: int
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    confidence: float = 1.0
    metadata: Optional[Dict] = None

@dataclass(slots=True)
class WDLSSignal:
    signal_id: int
    intent_hash: int
    pattern_hash: int
    response_code: int
    weight: float
    timestamp: float
    decay_rate: float = 0.1
    trend_impact: float = 0.0

    def apply_decay(self, current_time: float) -> float:
        elapsed_days = (current_time - self.timestamp) / 86400.0
        decay_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + self.decay_rate * elapsed_days)
        self.weight *= decay_factor
        self.timestamp = current_time
        return self.weight

@dataclass(slots=True)
class AuditEntry:
    entry_id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    timestamp: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    operation: str = ""
    data_hash: str = ""
    request_id: str = ""
    user_id: str = ""
    session_id: str = ""
    duration_ms: float = 0.0
    success: bool = True
    error_message: str = ""
    metadata: Dict = field(default_factory=dict)

# ======================================================================
# File: src/cdic/common/caches.py
from collections import OrderedDict
from threading import RLock

class LRUCache:
    """Thread-safe LRU cache."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 10000):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = OrderedDict()
        self.lock = RLock()

    def get(self, key):
        with self.lock:
            if key not in self.cache:
                return None
            self.cache.move_to_end(key)
            return self.cache[key]

    def put(self, key, value):
        with self.lock:
            if key in self.cache:
                self.cache.move_to_end(key)
            self.cache[key] = value
            if len(self.cache) > self.capacity:
                self.cache.popitem(last=False)

    def __contains__(self, key):
        with self.lock:
            return key in self.cache

    def __len__(self):
        with self.lock:
            return len(self.cache)

    def clear(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.cache.clear()

# Global caches
_prompt_cache = LRUCache(5000)
_option_template_cache = LRUCache(10000)
_context_vector_cache = LRUCache(10000)

# ======================================================================
# File: src/cdic/common/utils.py
import warnings
import importlib
from threading import Lock

_import_cache = {}
_import_lock = Lock()

def lazy_import(name: str):
    """Thread-safe lazy import with caching."""
    with _import_lock:
        if name not in _import_cache:
            try:
                if name == 'numpy':
                    import numpy as np
                    _import_cache[name] = np
                elif name == 'numba':
                    import numba
                    _import_cache[name] = numba
                elif name == 'cupy':
                    try:
                        import cupy as cp
                        _import_cache[name] = cp
                    except ImportError:
                        _import_cache[name] = None
                elif name == 'redis':
                    import redis
                    _import_cache[name] = redis
                elif name == 'msgpack':
                    import msgpack
                    _import_cache[name] = msgpack
                elif name == 'cryptography':
                    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, hmac
                    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.kdf.hkdf import HKDF
                    _import_cache[name] = {'hashes': hashes, 'hmac': hmac, 'HKDF': HKDF}
                elif name == 'psutil':
                    import psutil
                    _import_cache[name] = psutil
                else:
                    module = importlib.import_module(name)
                    _import_cache[name] = module
            except ImportError as e:
                warnings.warn(f"Failed to import {name}: {e}")
                _import_cache[name] = None
        return _import_cache[name]

from .ctif_gpu import CTIFEngineGPU

# File: src/cdic/engines/ctif_gpu.py
import time
import uuid
from threading import RLock
from typing import Dict, Optional
from ..common.utils import lazy_import
from ..common.caches import LRUCache, _context_vector_cache
from ..common.enums import TrendAuthority

class CTIFEngineGPU:
    """GPU-accelerated Contextual Trend Influence Factor engine with CPU fallback."""
    def __init__(self, max_signals: int = 1000, vector_dim: int = 128, use_gpu: bool = True):
        self.max_signals = max_signals
        self.vector_dim = vector_dim
        self.use_gpu = use_gpu
        self.gpu_available = False
        if use_gpu:
            cp = lazy_import('cupy')
            self.gpu_available = cp is not None
            if self.gpu_available:
                cp = lazy_import('cupy')
                self.trend_vectors_gpu = cp.zeros((max_signals, vector_dim), dtype=cp.float32)
                self.influences_gpu = cp.zeros(max_signals, dtype=cp.float32)
                self.authority_levels_gpu = cp.zeros(max_signals, dtype=cp.int8)
                self.timestamps_gpu = cp.zeros(max_signals, dtype=cp.float64)
                self.masks_gpu = cp.zeros(max_signals, dtype=cp.bool_)
        # CPU fallback arrays
        np = lazy_import('numpy')
        self.trend_vectors = np.zeros((max_signals, vector_dim), dtype=np.float32)
        self.influences = np.zeros(max_signals, dtype=np.float32)
        self.authority_levels = np.zeros(max_signals, dtype=np.int8)
        self.timestamps = np.zeros(max_signals, dtype=np.float64)
        self.masks = np.zeros(max_signals, dtype=np.bool_)

        self.signal_count = 0
        self.signal_map = {}      # signal_id -> index
        self.index_map = {}       # index -> signal_id
        self.lock = RLock()
        self.vector_cache = _context_vector_cache
        self.similarity_cache = LRUCache(5000)
        self.stats = {'gpu_ops': 0, 'cpu_ops': 0, 'cache_hits': 0}
        self.similarity_threshold = 0.7
        self._warmup()

    def _warmup(self):
        common_contexts = [
            {'action': 'recommend', 'category': 'general'},
            {'action': 'filter', 'type': 'content'},
            {'action': 'search', 'scope': 'global'}
        ]
        for ctx in common_contexts:
            _ = self.compute_context_vector(ctx)

    def compute_context_vector(self, context: Dict) -> np.ndarray:
        context_hash = hash(frozenset(context.items()))
        cached = self.vector_cache.get(context_hash)
        if cached is not None:
            self.stats['cache_hits'] += 1
            return cached
        np = lazy_import('numpy')
        # Use context_hash as seed for deterministic randomness
        rng = np.random.RandomState(context_hash)
        vector = rng.randn(self.vector_dim).astype(np.float32)
        norm = np.sqrt(np.dot(vector, vector))
        if norm > 0:
            vector /= norm
        self.vector_cache.put(context_hash, vector)
        return vector

    def _hash_context(self, context: Dict) -> int:
        return hash(frozenset(context.items()))

    def add_signal(self, context: Dict, influence: float, authority: TrendAuthority) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            if self.signal_count >= self.max_signals:
                self._evict_oldest(10)
            idx = self.signal_count
            if idx >= self.max_signals:
                # Try to find free slot
                for i in range(self.max_signals):
                    if i not in self.index_map:
                        idx = i
                        break
                else:
                    idx = self.signal_count % self.max_signals
            signal_id = uuid.uuid4().int
            vector = self.compute_context_vector(context)
            if self.gpu_available:
                cp = lazy_import('cupy')
                self.trend_vectors_gpu[idx] = cp.asarray(vector)
                self.influences_gpu[idx] = influence
                self.authority_levels_gpu[idx] = authority.value
                self.timestamps_gpu[idx] = time.time()
                self.masks_gpu[idx] = True
            else:
                self.trend_vectors[idx] = vector
                self.influences[idx] = influence
                self.authority_levels[idx] = authority.value
                self.timestamps[idx] = time.time()
                self.masks[idx] = True
            self.signal_map[signal_id] = idx
            self.index_map[idx] = signal_id
            self.signal_count = max(self.signal_count, idx + 1)
            return signal_id

    def get_contextual_influence(self, context: Dict, max_signals: int = 50) -> float:
        start_time = time.perf_counter()
        if self.signal_count == 0:
            return 0.0
        context_vector = self.compute_context_vector(context)
        if self.gpu_available:
            cp = lazy_import('cupy')
            context_gpu = cp.asarray(context_vector)
            active_mask = self.masks_gpu[:self.signal_count]
            if not cp.any(active_mask):
                return 0.0
            active_indices = cp.where(active_mask)[0]
            active_vectors = self.trend_vectors_gpu[active_indices]
            active_influences = self.influences_gpu[active_indices]
            similarities = cp.dot(active_vectors, context_gpu)
            threshold_mask = similarities > self.similarity_threshold
            if not cp.any(threshold_mask):
                return 0.0
            valid_indices = cp.where(threshold_mask)[0]
            valid_similarities = similarities[valid_indices]
            valid_influences = active_influences[valid_indices]
            k = min(max_signals, len(valid_similarities))
            if k > 0:
                # get top k indices
                top_k_indices = cp.argpartition(-valid_similarities, k)[:k]
                top_similarities = valid_similarities[top_k_indices]
                top_influences = valid_influences[top_k_indices]
                # Check immutable authority
                top_authorities = self.authority_levels_gpu[active_indices[valid_indices[top_k_indices]]]
                immutable_mask = top_authorities == TrendAuthority.IMMUTABLE.value
                if cp.any(immutable_mask):
                    # If any immutable, take only those (or highest?)
                    # For simplicity, take highest influence among immutable
                    top_similarities = top_similarities[immutable_mask]
                    top_influences = top_influences[immutable_mask]
                weighted_sum = cp.sum(top_influences * top_similarities)
                count = len(top_similarities)
                result = float(cp.clip(weighted_sum / max(count, 1), -1.0, 1.0))
                self.stats['gpu_ops'] += 1
                return result
        else:
            # CPU fallback
            np = lazy_import('numpy')
            active_indices = np.where(self.masks[:self.signal_count])[0]
            if len(active_indices) == 0:
                return 0.0
            active_vectors = self.trend_vectors[active_indices]
            similarities = np.dot(active_vectors, context_vector)
            threshold_mask = similarities > self.similarity_threshold
            valid_indices = active_indices[threshold_mask]
            if len(valid_indices) == 0:
                return 0.0
            k = min(max_signals, len(valid_indices))
            # Sort by similarity descending
            order = np.argsort(similarities[threshold_mask])[::-1][:k]
            valid_indices = valid_indices[order]
            top_similarities = similarities[valid_indices]
            top_influences = self.influences[valid_indices]
            top_authorities = self.authority_levels[valid_indices]
            immutable_mask = top_authorities == TrendAuthority.IMMUTABLE.value
            if np.any(immutable_mask):
                top_similarities = top_similarities[immutable_mask]
                top_influences = top_influences[immutable_mask]
            weighted_sum = np.sum(top_influences * top_similarities)
            count = len(top_similarities)
            result = float(np.clip(weighted_sum / max(count, 1), -1.0, 1.0))
            self.stats['cpu_ops'] += 1
            return result
        return 0.0

    def _evict_oldest(self, count: int):
        with self.lock:
            if self.signal_count == 0:
                return
            # sort timestamps and evict oldest
            if self.gpu_available:
                cp = lazy_import('cupy')
                # get indices sorted by timestamp
                oldest_indices = cp.argsort(self.timestamps_gpu[:self.signal_count])[:count]
                oldest_indices = cp.asnumpy(oldest_indices)
            else:
                np = lazy_import('numpy')
                oldest_indices = np.argsort(self.timestamps[:self.signal_count])[:count]
            for idx in oldest_indices:
                self._remove_signal_at_index(int(idx))

    def _remove_signal_at_index(self, idx: int):
        if idx < self.max_signals:
            if self.gpu_available:
                cp = lazy_import('cupy')
                self.trend_vectors_gpu[idx] = 0
                self.influences_gpu[idx] = 0
                self.authority_levels_gpu[idx] = 0
                self.timestamps_gpu[idx] = 0
                self.masks_gpu[idx] = False
            else:
                self.trend_vectors[idx] = 0
                self.influences[idx] = 0
                self.authority_levels[idx] = 0
                self.timestamps[idx] = 0
                self.masks[idx] = False
            signal_id = self.index_map.pop(idx, None)
            if signal_id:
                self.signal_map.pop(signal_id, None)
            # decrement signal_count if idx was last
            if idx == self.signal_count - 1:
                while self.signal_count > 0 and not self.masks[self.signal_count - 1]:
                    self.signal_count -= 1

# File: src/cdic/engines/wdls_vectorized.py
import time
import uuid
import pickle
from collections import deque
from threading import RLock, Thread
from typing import Optional, Dict
from ..common.utils import lazy_import

class WDLSEngineVectorized:
    """Vectorized WDLS engine with 100-signal cap, background decay, and cold store."""
    def __init__(self, max_realtime: int = 100, cold_store=None):
        self.max_realtime = max_realtime
        self.cold_store = cold_store
        np = lazy_import('numpy')
        self.weights = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.float32)
        self.trend_impacts = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.float64)
        self.timestamps = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.float32)
        self.decay_rates = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.float32)
        self.intent_hashes = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.int64)
        self.response_codes = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.int8)
        self.pattern_hashes = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.int64)
        self.signal_ids = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.int64)
        self.active_mask = np.zeros(max_realtime, dtype=np.bool_)

        self.signal_count = 0
        self.free_indices = deque(range(max_realtime))
        self.id_to_index = {}
        self.lock = RLock()

        # Background threads
        self.decay_thread = Thread(target=self._background_decay_worker, daemon=True)
        self.eviction_thread = Thread(target=self._background_eviction_worker, daemon=True)
        self.decay_thread.start()
        self.eviction_thread.start()

        self._compile_numba_functions()

    def _compile_numba_functions(self):
        try:
            numba = lazy_import('numba')
            np = lazy_import('numpy')
            @numba.njit(fastmath=True, parallel=True, cache=True)
            def apply_decay_batch(weights, decay_rates, timestamps, current_time, count):
                for i in numba.prange(count):
                    if weights[i] > 0:
                        elapsed = (current_time - timestamps[i]) / 86400.0
                        decay_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + decay_rates[i] * elapsed)
                        weights[i] *= decay_factor
                        timestamps[i] = current_time
                # No return, in-place modification
            self._apply_decay_batch_numba = apply_decay_batch

            @numba.njit(fastmath=True, cache=True)
            def compute_influence(intent_hash, intent_hashes, trend_impacts, weights,
                                  active_mask, count, max_cap):
                total_weight = 0.0
                total_influence = 0.0
                for i in range(count):
                    if (active_mask[i] and intent_hashes[i] == intent_hash and weights[i] > 0.01):
                        total_influence += trend_impacts[i] * weights[i]
                        total_weight += weights[i]
                if total_weight > 0:
                    weighted = total_influence / total_weight
                    if weighted > max_cap:
                        return max_cap
                    elif weighted < -max_cap:
                        return -max_cap
                    return weighted
                return 0.0
            self._compute_influence_numba = compute_influence
        except Exception:
            self._apply_decay_batch_numba = None
            self._compute_influence_numba = None

    def add_signal(self, intent_hash: int, pattern_hash: int, response_code: int,
                   weight: float, trend_impact: float) -> Optional[int]:
        with self.lock:
            if len(self.free_indices) == 0:
                self._evict_weakest(5)
            if len(self.free_indices) == 0:
                # fallback: evict oldest
                np = lazy_import('numpy')
                oldest = np.argmin(self.timestamps)
                self._remove_signal_at_index(oldest)
                self.free_indices.append(oldest)
            idx = self.free_indices.popleft()
            signal_id = uuid.uuid4().int
            self.weights[idx] = weight
            self.trend_impacts[idx] = trend_impact
            self.timestamps[idx] = time.time()
            self.decay_rates[idx] = 0.1
            self.intent_hashes[idx] = intent_hash
            self.response_codes[idx] = response_code
            self.pattern_hashes[idx] = pattern_hash
            self.signal_ids[idx] = signal_id
            self.active_mask[idx] = True
            self.id_to_index[signal_id] = idx
            self.signal_count += 1
            return signal_id

    def get_influence(self, intent_hash: int, max_cap: float = 0.15) -> float:
        if self.signal_count == 0:
            return 0.0
        current_time = time.time()
        np = lazy_import('numpy')
        # apply decay if last decay > 1 hour
        active_timestamps = self.timestamps[self.active_mask]
        if len(active_timestamps) > 0 and current_time - np.max(active_timestamps) > 3600:
            self._apply_batch_decay(current_time)
        if self._compute_influence_numba:
            influence = self._compute_influence_numba(
                intent_hash, self.intent_hashes, self.trend_impacts,
                self.weights, self.active_mask, self.max_realtime, max_cap
            )
        else:
            influence = self._compute_influence_python(intent_hash, max_cap)
        return influence

    def _compute_influence_python(self, intent_hash: int, max_cap: float) -> float:
        total_weight = 0.0
        total_influence = 0.0
        for i in range(self.max_realtime):
            if self.active_mask[i] and self.intent_hashes[i] == intent_hash and self.weights[i] > 0.01:
                total_influence += self.trend_impacts[i] * self.weights[i]
                total_weight += self.weights[i]
        if total_weight > 0:
            weighted = total_influence / total_weight
            return max(-max_cap, min(max_cap, weighted))
        return 0.0

    def _apply_batch_decay(self, current_time: float):
        if self._apply_decay_batch_numba:
            # Numba function modifies arrays in place
            self._apply_decay_batch_numba(
                self.weights, self.decay_rates, self.timestamps,
                current_time, self.max_realtime
            )
        else:
            for i in range(self.max_realtime):
                if self.active_mask[i] and self.weights[i] > 0:
                    elapsed = (current_time - self.timestamps[i]) / 86400.0
                    decay_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + self.decay_rates[i] * elapsed)
                    self.weights[i] *= decay_factor
                    self.timestamps[i] = current_time

    def _evict_weakest(self, count: int):
        with self.lock:
            if self.signal_count == 0:
                return
            np = lazy_import('numpy')
            active_indices = np.where(self.active_mask)[0]
            if len(active_indices) == 0:
                return
            # sort by weight ascending
            sorted_idx = active_indices[np.argsort(self.weights[active_indices])]
            to_evict = sorted_idx[:min(count, len(sorted_idx))]
            for idx in to_evict:
                self._remove_signal_at_index(idx)

    def _remove_signal_at_index(self, idx: int):
        if idx < self.max_realtime and self.active_mask[idx]:
            if self.cold_store and self.weights[idx] > 0.05:
                self._move_to_cold_store(idx)
            # Clear arrays
            self.weights[idx] = 0
            self.trend_impacts[idx] = 0
            self.timestamps[idx] = 0
            self.decay_rates[idx] = 0
            self.intent_hashes[idx] = 0
            self.response_codes[idx] = 0
            self.pattern_hashes[idx] = 0
            self.signal_ids[idx] = 0
            self.active_mask[idx] = False
            # remove from mapping
            signal_id = next((sid for sid, i in self.id_to_index.items() if i == idx), None)
            if signal_id:
                del self.id_to_index[signal_id]
            self.signal_count = max(0, self.signal_count - 1)
            self.free_indices.append(idx)

    def _move_to_cold_store(self, idx: int):
        if not self.cold_store:
            return
        signal_data = {
            'weight': float(self.weights[idx]),
            'trend_impact': float(self.trend_impacts[idx]),
            'timestamp': float(self.timestamps[idx]),
            'intent_hash': int(self.intent_hashes[idx]),
            'response_code': int(self.response_codes[idx]),
            'pattern_hash': int(self.pattern_hashes[idx])
        }
        key = f"wdls_cold:{self.signal_ids[idx]}"
        try:
            self.cold_store.setex(key, 86400 * 30, pickle.dumps(signal_data))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _background_decay_worker(self):
        while True:
            time.sleep(3600)  # hourly
            with self.lock:
                self._apply_batch_decay(time.time())

    def _background_eviction_worker(self):
        while True:
            time.sleep(1800)  # every 30 minutes
            with self.lock:
                if self.signal_count > self.max_realtime * 0.8:
                    self._evict_weakest(self.signal_count - int(self.max_realtime * 0.7))
