engine/ISCEngine.ts (with vocabulary, soft/hard veto, Redis cache)

```typescript
import { ISCEngine as IEngine, IdentitySafetyCore, AttributeType, DecisionSource, IAuditRepository, IISCRepository, AttributeVocabulary } from '../types';
import { RedisCache } from '../repositories/RedisCache';
import { logger } from '../logger';

export class ISCEngine {
  private cache: RedisCache;
  private vocabularyMap: Map<string, AttributeVocabulary>;
  private synonymIndex: Map<string, Set<string>>;

  constructor(private iscRepo: IISCRepository, private auditRepo: IAuditRepository, vocabulary: AttributeVocabulary[]) {
    this.cache = new RedisCache();
    this.vocabularyMap = new Map();
    this.synonymIndex = new Map();
    for (const v of vocabulary) {
      const key = `${v.attributeType}:${v.canonicalValue}`;
      this.vocabularyMap.set(key, v);
      for (const syn of v.synonyms) {
        const synKey = `${v.attributeType}:${syn}`;
        if (!this.synonymIndex.has(synKey)) this.synonymIndex.set(synKey, new Set());
        this.synonymIndex.get(synKey)!.add(v.canonicalValue);
      }
    }
  }

  async isAllowed(userId: string, attributes: Record<AttributeType, string>, requestId: string): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; vetoReason?: string; rigidity?: number }> {
    const cacheKey = `isc:${userId}:${JSON.stringify(attributes)}`;
    const cached = await this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached === 'false') return { allowed: false, vetoReason: 'cached veto' };
    if (cached === 'true') return { allowed: true };

    try {
      const isc = await this.iscRepo.getCurrentISC(userId);
      for (const constraint of isc.constraints.values()) {
        const attrValue = attributes[constraint.attributeType];
        if (!attrValue) continue;

        // Direct match
        if (attrValue === constraint.attributeValue) {
          return this.handleVeto(userId, requestId, attributes, constraint, requestId);
        }
        // Synonym match
        const synKey = `${constraint.attributeType}:${attrValue}`;
        const synonyms = this.synonymIndex.get(synKey);
        if (synonyms && synonyms.has(constraint.attributeValue)) {
          return this.handleVeto(userId, requestId, attributes, constraint, requestId);
        }
      }
      await this.cache.set(cacheKey, 'true', 300);
      return { allowed: true };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`ISC Engine error for ${userId}`, error);
      await this.auditRepo.logEntry({
        timestamp: new Date(),
        userId,
        module: 'ISC_ENGINE',
        action: 'ERROR',
        decisionSource: DecisionSource.ISC_VETO,
        attributes,
        result: 'DENY',
        reason: `System error: ${error.message}`,
        metadata: { requestId }
      });
      return { allowed: false, vetoReason: 'System error' };
    }
  }

  private async handleVeto(userId: string, requestId: string, attributes: Record<AttributeType, string>, constraint: any, requestId: string) {
    const isHardVeto = constraint.rigidity >= 0.8;
    const result = isHardVeto ? 'DENY' : 'ALLOW';
    await this.auditRepo.logEntry({
      timestamp: new Date(),
      userId,
      module: 'ISC_ENGINE',
      action: 'VETO',
      decisionSource: DecisionSource.ISC_VETO,
      attributes,
      result,
      reason: constraint.reason,
      vetoMetadata: {
        domainTags: Array.from(constraint.domains),
        rigidityAtTime: constraint.rigidity,
        driftInteractionScore: 0, // Not used (no inference)
        contextSnapshot: {}
      },
      metadata: { requestId }
    });
    if (isHardVeto) {
      await this.cache.set(`isc:${userId}:${JSON.stringify(attributes)}`, 'false', 300);
      return { allowed: false, vetoReason: constraint.reason, rigidity: constraint.rigidity };
    }
    return { allowed: true }; // soft veto allows
  }
}
```

engine/ContextualResolver.ts (full implementation with rigidity modifier)

```typescript
import { ContextualConstraintResolver as IResolver, Constraint, ContextBinding, ContextScope, ConstraintType, IConstraintRepository, IAuditRepository } from '../types';
import { RedisCache } from '../repositories/RedisCache';

export class ContextualResolver {
  private cache: RedisCache;
  constructor(private constraintRepo: IConstraintRepository, private auditRepo: IAuditRepository) {
    this.cache = new RedisCache();
  }

  async getActiveConstraints(userId: string, context: Map<ContextScope, string>): Promise<Constraint[]> {
    const cacheKey = `ctx:${userId}:${this.hashContext(context)}`;
    const cached = await this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) return JSON.parse(cached);

    const allConstraints = await this.constraintRepo.getConstraints(userId);
    const active: Constraint[] = [];
    for (const constraint of allConstraints) {
      if (constraint.type !== ConstraintType.CONTEXTUAL || !constraint.isActive) continue;
      // Check bindings (simplified: assume bindings stored in constraint metadata)
      const bindings = constraint.metadata?.contextBindings as ContextBinding[] || [];
      for (const binding of bindings) {
        if (binding.isActive && (!binding.expiresAt || binding.expiresAt > new Date())) {
          const contextValue = context.get(binding.contextType);
          if (contextValue === binding.contextValue) {
            // Apply rigidity modifier
            const modifiedRigidity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, constraint.rigidity + binding.rigidityModifier));
            active.push({ ...constraint, rigidity: modifiedRigidity });
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    await this.cache.set(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(active), 60);
    return active;
  }

  private hashContext(context: Map<ContextScope, string>): string {
    const sorted = Array.from(context.entries()).sort(([a],[b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
    return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(sorted)).toString('base64');
  }
}
```

engine/NegativePreferenceGraph.ts (with Redis storage, closure cache, no inference)

```typescript
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import Redis from 'ioredis';
import { NegativePreferenceNode, PreferenceEdge } from '../types';
import { config } from '../config';
import { logger } from '../logger';

export class NegativePreferenceGraph extends EventEmitter {
  private redis: Redis;
  private closureCache: Map<string, Set<string>> = new Map();
  constructor(private auditRepo: any) {
    super();
    this.redis = new Redis(config.redis.url);
  }

  async addNode(userId: string, node: NegativePreferenceNode): Promise<void> {
    const key = `graph:${userId}:node:${node.nodeId}`;
    const data = {
      ...node,
      edges: JSON.stringify([...node.edges.entries()]), // store as array of [key, edge]
      createdAt: node.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updatedAt: node.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    };
    await this.redis.hset(key, data);
    this.closureCache.clear();
    this.emit('node_added', { userId, nodeId: node.nodeId });
  }

  async generateExclusionSet(userId: string, triggerNodeId: string, context?: Map<string, string>): Promise<Set<string>> {
    const cacheKey = `${userId}:${triggerNodeId}:${this.hashContext(context)}`;
    if (this.closureCache.has(cacheKey)) return this.closureCache.get(cacheKey)!;

    const exclusionSet = new Set<string>();
    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const queue = [{ nodeId: triggerNodeId, depth: 0 }];
    const maxDepth = 3;

    while (queue.length) {
      const { nodeId, depth } = queue.shift()!;
      if (visited.has(nodeId) || depth > maxDepth) continue;
      visited.add(nodeId);
      const node = await this.getNode(userId, nodeId);
      if (!node) continue;
      if (depth > 0 && node.isIscOriginated) continue;
      exclusionSet.add(nodeId);
      const edges = await this.getEdges(userId, nodeId);
      for (const edge of edges) {
        if (edge.confidenceScore >= 0.7 && this.isEdgeActiveInContext(edge, context)) {
          queue.push({ nodeId: edge.targetNodeId, depth: depth + 1 });
        }
      }
    }
    this.closureCache.set(cacheKey, exclusionSet);
    return exclusionSet;
  }

  private async getNode(userId: string, nodeId: string): Promise<NegativePreferenceNode | null> {
    const key = `graph:${userId}:node:${nodeId}`;
    const data = await this.redis.hgetall(key);
    if (!data || !data.nodeId) return null;
    return {
      ...data,
      edges: new Map(JSON.parse(data.edges)),
      createdAt: new Date(data.createdAt),
      updatedAt: new Date(data.updatedAt),
    } as any;
  }

  private async getEdges(userId: string, sourceNodeId: string): Promise<PreferenceEdge[]> {
    const node = await this.getNode(userId, sourceNodeId);
    return node ? Array.from(node.edges.values()) : [];
  }

  private isEdgeActiveInContext(edge: PreferenceEdge, context?: Map<string, string>): boolean {
    if (!context) return true;
    const restrictions = (edge as any).contextRestrictions;
    if (!restrictions) return true;
    for (const [scope, value] of context.entries()) {
      if (restrictions[scope] && restrictions[scope] !== value) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  private hashContext(context?: Map<string, string>): string {
    if (!context) return 'none';
    const sorted = Array.from(context.entries()).sort(([a],[b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
    return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(sorted)).toString('base64');
  }
}
```

engine/EnforcementGate.ts (with PPL integration, final score, permanent exclusion check)

```typescript
import { EnforcementGate as IGate, DecisionSource, AttributeType, IAuditRepository } from '../types';
import { PositivePreferenceLayer } from '../ppl/PositivePreferenceLayer';
import { ISCEngine } from './ISCEngine';
import { ContextualResolver } from './ContextualResolver';
import { NegativePreferenceGraph } from './NegativePreferenceGraph';
import { RedisCache } from '../repositories/RedisCache';
import { logger } from '../logger';

export class EnforcementGate {
  private cache: RedisCache;
  constructor(
    private iscEngine: ISCEngine,
    private contextualResolver: ContextualResolver,
    private graph: NegativePreferenceGraph,
    private auditRepo: IAuditRepository,
    private ppl: PositivePreferenceLayer
  ) {
    this.cache = new RedisCache();
  }

  async evaluateItem(request: { userId: string; itemId: string; attributes: Record<AttributeType, string>; priority: number }): Promise<EvaluationResult> {
    const start = Date.now();
    const reasons: string[] = [];
    const sources: DecisionSource[] = [];

    // 1. ISC check (hard veto if rigidity >= 0.8)
    const iscResult = await this.iscEngine.isAllowed(request.userId, request.attributes, request.itemId);
    if (!iscResult.allowed && iscResult.rigidity && iscResult.rigidity >= 0.8) {
      await this.logDecision(request, false, reasons, sources, start);
      return { allowed: false, reasons: [iscResult.vetoReason!], sources: [DecisionSource.ISC_VETO], processingTime: Date.now() - start };
    }

    // 2. Contextual constraints (with rigidity)
    const context = new Map(); // would be fetched from user session
    const activeConstraints = await this.contextualResolver.getActiveConstraints(request.userId, context);
    for (const c of activeConstraints) {
      if (c.attributeValue === request.attributes[c.attributeType]) {
        if (c.rigidity >= 0.8) {
          reasons.push(`Contextual constraint: ${c.reason}`);
          sources.push(DecisionSource.CONTEXTUAL);
          await this.logDecision(request, false, reasons, sources, start);
          return { allowed: false, reasons, sources, processingTime: Date.now() - start };
        } else {
          reasons.push(`Soft contextual: ${c.reason}`);
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. NPG exclusions (with elastic threshold? No, no inference – we just check)
    const exclusions = await this.graph.generateExclusionSet(request.userId, 'trigger', context);
    if (exclusions.size > 0) {
      reasons.push(`NPG exclusion (${exclusions.size} nodes)`);
      sources.push(DecisionSource.NPG);
      await this.logDecision(request, false, reasons, sources, start);
      return { allowed: false, reasons, sources, processingTime: Date.now() - start };
    }

    // 4. Positive Preference Layer score (explicit user likes only)
    const pplScore = await this.ppl.getScore(request.userId, request.itemId);
    // NPL penalty: 0 if no veto, 0.5 if soft veto, 1 if hard veto (but hard already returned)
    const nplPenalty = 0; // no hard veto remained
    const finalScore = pplScore - nplPenalty;
    const allowed = finalScore >= 0;
    if (!allowed) reasons.push('Positive preference score too low');
    await this.logDecision(request, allowed, reasons, sources, start);
    return { allowed, reasons, sources, processingTime: Date.now() - start };
  }

  private async logDecision(request: any, allowed: boolean, reasons: string[], sources: DecisionSource[], start: number) {
    await this.auditRepo.logEntry({
      timestamp: new Date(),
      userId: request.userId,
      module: 'ENFORCEMENT_GATE',
      action: 'EVALUATION',
      decisionSource: sources[0] || DecisionSource.ENFORCEMENT_GATE,
      itemId: request.itemId,
      attributes: request.attributes,
      result: allowed ? 'ALLOW' : 'DENY',
      reason: reasons.join('; ') || 'All checks passed',
      metadata: { requestId: request.itemId, processingTime: Date.now() - start, sources }
    });
  }
}
```

engine/DigitalWardrobe.ts (full cartesian outfit generation, permanent exclusion tracking)

```typescript
import { WardrobeItem, AttributeType, IPermanentExclusionRepository } from '../types';
import { EnforcementGate } from './EnforcementGate';
import { RedisCache } from '../repositories/RedisCache';
import { config } from '../config';

export class DigitalWardrobe {
  private userWardrobes: Map<string, Map<string, WardrobeItem>> = new Map();
  private cache: RedisCache;
  constructor(private enforcementGate: EnforcementGate, private permExclusionRepo: IPermanentExclusionRepository) {
    this.cache = new RedisCache();
  }

  async filterWardrobe(userId: string): Promise<WardrobeItem[]> {
    const wardrobe = this.userWardrobes.get(userId);
    if (!wardrobe) return [];
    const items = Array.from(wardrobe.values());
    const filtered: WardrobeItem[] = [];
    for (const item of items) {
      const excluded = await this.permExclusionRepo.isExcluded(userId, item.itemId);
      if (excluded) continue;
      const result = await this.enforcementGate.evaluateItem({ userId, itemId: item.itemId, attributes: item.attributes, priority: 1 });
      if (result.allowed) {
        filtered.push(item);
      } else {
        await this.trackRejection(userId, item, result.reasons.join(','));
      }
    }
    return filtered;
  }

  private async trackRejection(userId: string, item: WardrobeItem, reason: string) {
    const key = `rejection:${userId}:${item.itemId}`;
    const count = await this.cache.get(key);
    const newCount = (parseInt(count || '0') + 1);
    if (newCount >= config.npl.permanentExclusionThreshold) {
      await this.permExclusionRepo.addExclusion({
        userId,
        itemId: item.itemId,
        domain: 'general',
        rejectionCount: newCount,
        threshold: config.npl.permanentExclusionThreshold,
        reason,
        rigidityAtTime: 1.0,
        createdAt: new Date(),
      });
      await this.cache.del(key);
    } else {
      await this.cache.set(key, newCount.toString(), 86400);
    }
  }

  generateOutfits(items: WardrobeItem[], rule: OutfitRule, maxOutfits: number): WardrobeItem[][] {
    // Group by category (each item can have multiple categories; we'll use first category for simplicity)
    const byCategory = new Map<string, WardrobeItem[]>();
    for (const item of items) {
      const cat = Array.from(item.categories)[0];
      if (!byCategory.has(cat)) byCategory.set(cat, []);
      byCategory.get(cat)!.push(item);
    }
    // Cartesian product
    let combinations: WardrobeItem[][] = [[]];
    for (const cat of rule.categories) {
      const catItems = byCategory.get(cat) || [];
      if (catItems.length === 0) return [];
      const newCombos: WardrobeItem[][] = [];
      for (const combo of combinations) {
        for (const item of catItems) {
          newCombos.push([...combo, item]);
        }
      }
      combinations = newCombos;
    }
    // Filter by min/max items and exclusive categories
    const valid = combinations.filter(combo => combo.length >= rule.minItems && combo.length <= rule.maxItems && this.validateExclusive(combo, rule));
    return valid.slice(0, maxOutfits);
  }

  private validateExclusive(outfit: WardrobeItem[], rule: OutfitRule): boolean {
    for (const pair of rule.exclusiveCategories) {
      const [cat1, cat2] = pair;
      const has1 = outfit.some(i => i.categories.has(cat1));
      const has2 = outfit.some(i => i.categories.has(cat2));
      if (has1 && has2) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

import { TariInterface as ITari, DecisionSource, IISCRepository, IAuditRepository, IConstraintRepository } from '../types';
import { generateHash } from '../utils/hash';
import { logger } from '../logger';

export class TariInterface {
  constructor(private iscRepo: IISCRepository, private auditRepo: IAuditRepository, private constraintRepo: IConstraintRepository) {}

  async handleRequest(request: any): Promise<any> {
    // Rate limiting, validation, action dispatch
    switch (request.action) {
      case 'REQUEST_EXPLANATION':
        return this.generateExplanation(request.userId, request.parameters);
      case 'SURFACE_AUDIT_HISTORY':
        return this.getAuditHistory(request.userId, request.parameters);
      case 'ASK_CONFIRMATION':
        return this.createConfirmation(request.userId, request.parameters);
      case 'GET_ISC_HISTORY':
        return this.iscRepo.getVersionHistory(request.userId);
      case 'GET_CONSTRAINT_DETAILS':
        return this.constraintRepo.getConstraints(request.userId);
      case 'EXPORT_AUDIT_LOGS':
        return this.exportLogs(request.userId, request.parameters);
      default:
        throw new Error('Unknown action');
    }
  }

  private async generateExplanation(userId: string, params: any) {
    const logs = await this.auditRepo.getEntries(userId, { itemId: params.itemId, startDate: params.startDate, endDate: params.endDate });
    return { explanations: logs.map(l => ({ timestamp: l.timestamp, reason: l.reason, source: l.decisionSource })) };
  }

  private async getAuditHistory(userId: string, params: any) { /* similar */ }
  private async createConfirmation(userId: string, params: any) { /* generate token, store in DB with expiry */ }
  private async exportLogs(userId: string, params: any) { /* CSV/JSON */ }

  // Forbidden methods
  public modifyISC(): never { throw new Error('Tari cannot modify ISC'); }
  public persuadeUser(): never { throw new Error('Tari cannot persuade'); }
}

engine/ISCEvolutionProtocol.ts (with Bull queue, transactions)

```typescript
import { DataSource, QueryRunner } from 'typeorm';
import { ISCEvolutionProtocol as IEvolution, IdentitySafetyCore, ConstraintChange, ChangeType, EvolutionStatus } from '../types';
import { coolingQueue } from '../repositories/BullQueue';
import { logger } from '../logger';

export class ISCEvolutionProtocol {
  private queryRunner: QueryRunner | null = null;
  constructor(private iscRepo: any, private auditRepo: any, private constraintRepo: any, private dataSource: DataSource) {}

  async initiateEvolution(userId: string, changes: ConstraintChange[], reason?: string) {
    const currentISC = await this.iscRepo.getCurrentISC(userId);
    const event = {
      eventId: `evol_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36)}`,
      userId,
      previousVersion: currentISC.version,
      newVersion: currentISC.version + 1,
      changes,
      coolingPeriodEnds: new Date(Date.now() + config.npl.coolingPeriodHours * 3600000),
      status: EvolutionStatus.COOLING,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      confirmationToken: require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),
    };
    // Save to pending evolutions table
    await this.dataSource.getRepository('PendingEvolutionEntity').save({ userId, eventId: event.eventId, event, timeoutAt: event.coolingPeriodEnds });
    // Schedule job
    await coolingQueue.add({ userId, eventId: event.eventId }, { delay: config.npl.coolingPeriodHours * 3600000 });
    return { event, validation: { isValid: true, errors: [], warnings: [] } };
  }

  async confirmEvolution(userId: string, token: string, confirmImmutable: boolean) {
    const pending = await this.dataSource.getRepository('PendingEvolutionEntity').findOne({ where: { userId } });
    if (!pending) throw new Error('No pending evolution');
    if (pending.event.confirmationToken !== token) throw new Error('Invalid token');
    if (pending.event.coolingPeriodEnds > new Date()) throw new Error('Cooling period not expired');

    this.queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner();
    await this.queryRunner.connect();
    await this.queryRunner.startTransaction();
    try {
      const currentISC = await this.iscRepo.getCurrentISC(userId);
      const newISC = await this.applyChanges(currentISC, pending.event.changes);
      await this.iscRepo.saveISC(newISC);
      await this.queryRunner.manager.delete('PendingEvolutionEntity', { userId });
      await this.queryRunner.commitTransaction();
      await this.auditRepo.logEntry({ /* log success */ });
      return { success: true, newISC };
    } catch (err) {
      await this.queryRunner.rollbackTransaction();
      throw err;
    } finally {
      await this.queryRunner.release();
    }
  }

  private async applyChanges(currentISC: IdentitySafetyCore, changes: ConstraintChange[]): Promise<IdentitySafetyCore> {
    const newConstraints = new Map(currentISC.constraints);
    for (const change of changes) {
      if (change.changeType === ChangeType.ADDED) {
        newConstraints.set(change.constraintId, { ...change.newState, createdAt: new Date(), createdBy: 'USER', isImmutable: false });
      } else if (change.changeType === ChangeType.REMOVED) {
        newConstraints.delete(change.constraintId);
      } else if (change.changeType === ChangeType.MODIFIED) {
        const existing = newConstraints.get(change.constraintId);
        if (existing) newConstraints.set(change.constraintId, { ...existing, ...change.newState });
      }
      // DOWNGRADED_* would remove from ISC and add to contextual/graph stores (omitted for brevity)
    }
    return { ...currentISC, version: currentISC.version + 1, constraints: newConstraints, updatedAt: new Date(), checksum: generateISCChecksum(newConstraints) };
  }
}

src/tari/orchestrator/gateway.py
"""
Xyra Gateway Orchestrator – routes requests to agents, handles timeouts, retries, tracing.
"""
import asyncio
import time
import uuid
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from ..config import TariConfig
from ..connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ..cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ..privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from .agents.conversation_agent import ConversationAgent
from .agents.retrieval_agent import RetrievalAgent
from .agents.outfit_agent import OutfitAgent
from .agents.tryon_agent import TryOnAgent
from .agents.learning_agent import LearningAgent
from .memory.memory_service import MemoryService
from .knowledge_graph import FashionKnowledgeGraph

@dataclass
class OrchestrationContext:
    request_id: str
    user_id: str
    query: str
    context: Dict[str, Any]
    start_time: float = field(default_factory=time.perf_counter)
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

class XyraGatewayOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        # Agents
        self.conversation_agent = ConversationAgent(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.retrieval_agent = RetrievalAgent(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.outfit_agent = OutfitAgent(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.tryon_agent = TryOnAgent(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.learning_agent = LearningAgent(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.memory_service = MemoryService(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)
        self.knowledge_graph = FashionKnowledgeGraph(config)
        # State
        self._active_requests: Dict[str, OrchestrationContext] = {}

    async def process(self, user_id: str, query: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        orch_ctx = OrchestrationContext(
            request_id=request_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            query=query,
            context=context
        )
        self._active_requests[request_id] = orch_ctx
        try:
            # Step 1: Intent parsing (conversation agent)
            intent = await self.conversation_agent.parse_intent(query, context)
            # Step 2: Retrieve user memory
            user_profile = await self.memory_service.get_user_profile(user_id)
            # Step 3: Style embedding generation (via retrieval agent)
            style_embedding = await self.retrieval_agent.generate_style_embedding(intent, user_profile)
            # Step 4: Semantic product retrieval
            products = await self.retrieval_agent.retrieve_products(style_embedding, intent, user_profile)
            # Step 5: Outfit composition
            outfits = await self.outfit_agent.compose_outfits(products, intent, user_profile)
            # Step 6: XARI ranking
            ranked_outfits = await self.learning_agent.rank_outfits(outfits, user_id, context)
            # Step 7: Generate variations (if requested)
            if context.get("generate_variations"):
                ranked_outfits = await self.outfit_agent.generate_variations(ranked_outfits, intent)
            # Step 8: Trigger try-on asynchronously (if user selects a look)
            tryon_job = None
            if context.get("auto_tryon") and ranked_outfits:
                selected_outfit = ranked_outfits[0]
                tryon_job = await self.tryon_agent.queue_tryon(user_id, selected_outfit, context)
            # Step 9: Prepare response
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - orch_ctx.start_time) * 1000
            response = {
                "request_id": request_id,
                "intent": intent,
                "products": products[:12],
                "outfits": ranked_outfits[:4],
                "tryon_job": tryon_job,
                "performance": {"elapsed_ms": elapsed_ms}
            }
            # Step 10: Async feedback learning
            asyncio.create_task(self.learning_agent.record_interaction(user_id, query, response, context))
            return response
        except Exception as e:
            return {"error": str(e), "request_id": request_id}
        finally:
            self._active_requests.pop(request_id, None)

    async def health_check(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "orchestrator": "healthy",
            "agents": {
                "conversation": await self.conversation_agent.health(),
                "retrieval": await self.retrieval_agent.health(),
                "outfit": await self.outfit_agent.health(),
                "tryon": await self.tryon_agent.health(),
                "learning": await self.learning_agent.health(),
            },
            "memory": await self.memory_service.health(),
            "knowledge_graph": await self.knowledge_graph.health()
        }
```

src/tari/orchestrator/agents/conversation_agent.py
"""
Xyra Conversation Agent – intent parsing, dialogue, clarification.
"""
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
import numpy as np
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ...dialogue.nlp_processor import NLPProcessor
from ...dialogue.orchestrator import DialogueOrchestrator

class ConversationAgent:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self.nlp = NLPProcessor()
        self.dialogue = DialogueOrchestrator(config, cache)

    async def parse_intent(self, query: str, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Translate natural language into structured fashion intent.
        Uses embedding extraction, semantic similarity, multi-attribute reasoning.
        """
        # Extract embedding (placeholder – use CLIP or similar)
        embedding = await self._get_embedding(query)
        # Parse with NLP
        intent_result = await self.nlp.parse_intent(query)
        intent = intent_result.get("intent", "general")
        confidence = intent_result.get("confidence", 0.5)
        # Extract structured fields
        structured = self._extract_fashion_attributes(query, context)
        # If confidence low, ask clarifying question
        if confidence < 0.55:
            clarification = await self._generate_clarification(structured)
            return {
                "needs_clarification": True,
                "clarification_question": clarification,
                "partial_intent": structured,
                "confidence": confidence
            }
        return {
            "occasion": structured.get("occasion", []),
            "aesthetics": structured.get("aesthetics", []),
            "colors": structured.get("colors", []),
            "weather": structured.get("weather"),
            "genderPresentation": structured.get("genderPresentation"),
            "budgetTier": structured.get("budgetTier"),
            "fitPreference": structured.get("fitPreference"),
            "luxuryLevel": structured.get("luxuryLevel", 0.5),
            "formality": structured.get("formality", 0.5),
            "season": structured.get("season"),
            "vibe": structured.get("vibe", []),
            "embedding": embedding,
            "confidence": confidence
        }

    async def _get_embedding(self, text: str) -> List[float]:
        # Placeholder – use CLIP or other embedding model
        import hashlib
        hash_bytes = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).digest()[:32]
        return [float(b) / 255.0 for b in hash_bytes]

    def _extract_fashion_attributes(self, query: str, context: Dict) -> Dict:
        # Simplified – in production use fine-tuned LLM or BERT-based classifier
        query_lower = query.lower()
        attributes = {
            "occasion": [],
            "aesthetics": [],
            "colors": [],
            "vibe": []
        }
        occasion_keywords = {
            "work": ["work", "office", "business", "corporate"],
            "date": ["date", "romantic", "dinner"],
            "casual": ["casual", "everyday", "weekend"],
            "party": ["party", "club", "evening", "gala"]
        }
        for occ, keywords in occasion_keywords.items():
            if any(k in query_lower for k in keywords):
                attributes["occasion"].append(occ)
        aesthetic_keywords = {
            "minimalist": ["minimal", "clean", "simple", "monochrome"],
            "streetwear": ["street", "hoodie", "sneaker", "urban"],
            "luxury": ["luxury", "premium", "high-end", "designer"],
            "vintage": ["vintage", "retro", "90s", "80s"],
            "futuristic": ["futuristic", "cyberpunk", "techwear", "modern"],
            "bohemian": ["boho", "flowy", "earthy", "bohemian"]
        }
        for aest, keywords in aesthetic_keywords.items():
            if any(k in query_lower for k in keywords):
                attributes["aesthetics"].append(aest)
        color_keywords = {
            "black": ["black", "dark"],
            "white": ["white", "cream"],
            "grey": ["grey", "gray"],
            "blue": ["blue", "navy"],
            "red": ["red", "crimson"],
            "green": ["green", "olive"],
            "beige": ["beige", "tan", "khaki"]
        }
        for col, keywords in color_keywords.items():
            if any(k in query_lower for k in keywords):
                attributes["colors"].append(col)
        vibe_keywords = {
            "edgy": ["edgy", "punk", "rock"],
            "elegant": ["elegant", "classy", "sophisticated"],
            "fun": ["fun", "colorful", "playful"],
            "serious": ["serious", "professional", "formal"]
        }
        for vibe, keywords in vibe_keywords.items():
            if any(k in query_lower for k in keywords):
                attributes["vibe"].append(vibe)
        # Weather
        if "rain" in query_lower or "rainy" in query_lower:
            attributes["weather"] = "rainy"
        elif "snow" in query_lower:
            attributes["weather"] = "snow"
        elif "hot" in query_lower:
            attributes["weather"] = "hot"
        elif "cold" in query_lower:
            attributes["weather"] = "cold"
        # Budget
        if "budget" in query_lower or "cheap" in query_lower:
            attributes["budgetTier"] = "low"
        elif "luxury" in query_lower or "premium" in query_lower:
            attributes["budgetTier"] = "high"
        else:
            attributes["budgetTier"] = "medium"
        # Formality
        if any(k in query_lower for k in ["formal", "business", "work"]):
            attributes["formality"] = 0.8
        elif any(k in query_lower for k in ["casual", "everyday"]):
            attributes["formality"] = 0.3
        else:
            attributes["formality"] = 0.5
        # Luxury level
        if "luxury" in query_lower or "premium" in query_lower:
            attributes["luxuryLevel"] = 0.9
        elif "budget" in query_lower:
            attributes["luxuryLevel"] = 0.2
        else:
            attributes["luxuryLevel"] = 0.5
        return attributes

    async def _generate_clarification(self, partial_intent: Dict) -> str:
        if not partial_intent.get("aesthetics"):
            return "What style aesthetic are you looking for? (e.g., minimalist, streetwear, luxury)"
        if not partial_intent.get("occasion"):
            return "What occasion will you be wearing this for?"
        if not partial_intent.get("colors"):
            return "Do you have any color preferences?"
        return "Could you provide more details about the look you want?"

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"agent": "conversation", "status": "healthy"}

src/tari/orchestrator/agents/retrieval_agent.py
"""
Retrieval Agent – semantic search with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + behavioral boost).
"""
import asyncio
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ...similarity.engine import VectorSimilarityEngine

class RetrievalAgent:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self.vector_engine = VectorSimilarityEngine(config.MAX_EMBEDDING_DIM)
        self._product_index = None
        self._bm25_index = None  # would be built from product descriptions

    async def generate_style_embedding(self, intent: Dict, user_profile: Dict) -> np.ndarray:
        """
        Convert user intent and profile into a unified embedding vector.
        """
        # In production: use CLIP or FashionCLIP to embed the intent text
        # For now, create a dummy embedding
        embedding = np.random.randn(self.config.MAX_EMBEDDING_DIM).astype(np.float32)
        embedding = embedding / np.linalg.norm(embedding)
        return embedding

    async def retrieve_products(self, style_embedding: np.ndarray,
                                intent: Dict, user_profile: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Hybrid retrieval: vector search + BM25 + behavioral boost + freshness + inventory.
        """
        # Step 1: Vector search (top 200)
        vector_results = await self._vector_search(style_embedding, top_k=self.config.RETRIEVAL_TOP_K)
        # Step 2: BM25 (text match on product descriptions)
        bm25_results = await self._bm25_search(intent, top_k=self.config.RETRIEVAL_TOP_K)
        # Step 3: Merge with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF)
        merged = self._reciprocal_rank_fusion(vector_results, bm25_results, k=60)
        # Step 4: Apply behavioral boost (based on user profile)
        boosted = self._apply_behavioral_boost(merged, user_profile)
        # Step 5: Apply freshness and inventory score
        final = self._apply_inventory_and_freshness(boosted)
        # Step 6: Diversity re-ranking (MMR)
        diverse = self._maximal_marginal_relevance(style_embedding, final, lambda_d=self.config.DIVERSITY_LAMBDA)
        # Step 7: Return top 12
        return diverse[:self.config.FINAL_TOP_K]

    async def _vector_search(self, embedding: np.ndarray, top_k: int) -> List[Dict]:
        # Placeholder – query vector DB
        # In production: Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or FAISS
        results = []
        # Dummy results
        for i in range(top_k):
            results.append({
                "product_id": f"prod_{i}",
                "score": 1.0 - (i / top_k),
                "embedding": np.random.randn(self.config.MAX_EMBEDDING_DIM).astype(np.float32),
                "metadata": {"category": "top", "color": "black", "price": 50 + i}
            })
        return results

    async def _bm25_search(self, intent: Dict, top_k: int) -> List[Dict]:
        # Placeholder – use Whoosh, Elasticsearch, or a simple TF-IDF
        results = []
        for i in range(top_k):
            results.append({
                "product_id": f"prod_{i}",
                "score": 0.9 - (i / top_k),
                "metadata": {}
            })
        return results

    def _reciprocal_rank_fusion(self, list_a: List[Dict], list_b: List[Dict], k: int = 60) -> List[Dict]:
        scores = {}
        for rank, item in enumerate(list_a):
            rid = item["product_id"]
            scores[rid] = scores.get(rid, 0) + 1.0 / (k + rank + 1)
        for rank, item in enumerate(list_b):
            rid = item["product_id"]
            scores[rid] = scores.get(rid, 0) + 1.0 / (k + rank + 1)
        sorted_ids = sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        merged = []
        for rid, score in sorted_ids:
            # Find the full item from either list
            item = next((x for x in list_a if x["product_id"] == rid), None)
            if not item:
                item = next((x for x in list_b if x["product_id"] == rid), None)
            if item:
                item["fusion_score"] = score
                merged.append(item)
        return merged

    def _apply_behavioral_boost(self, items: List[Dict], user_profile: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        # Boost products similar to user's liked styles
        liked_styles = user_profile.get("likedStyles", [])
        for item in items:
            item_tags = item.get("metadata", {}).get("styleTags", [])
            boost = 1.0
            for tag in item_tags:
                if tag in liked_styles:
                    boost *= 1.2
            item["score"] = item.get("fusion_score", 0.5) * boost
        items.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
        return items

    def _apply_inventory_and_freshness(self, items: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        # Placeholder – filter out out-of-stock and boost new arrivals
        return items

    def _maximal_marginal_relevance(self, query_embedding: np.ndarray, items: List[Dict],
                                    lambda_d: float = 0.5) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        MMR algorithm for diversity.
        """
        if not items:
            return []
        selected = []
        remaining = items.copy()
        # Precompute item embeddings
        for item in remaining:
            if "embedding" not in item:
                item["embedding"] = np.random.randn(self.config.MAX_EMBEDDING_DIM).astype(np.float32)
                item["embedding"] /= np.linalg.norm(item["embedding"])
        # Select first item
        first = max(remaining, key=lambda x: x["score"])
        selected.append(first)
        remaining.remove(first)
        while remaining and len(selected) < self.config.FINAL_TOP_K:
            mmr_scores = []
            for item in remaining:
                rel = item["score"]
                sim_max = max([self._cosine_sim(item["embedding"], sel["embedding"]) for sel in selected])
                mmr = lambda_d * rel - (1 - lambda_d) * sim_max
                mmr_scores.append(mmr)
            best_idx = np.argmax(mmr_scores)
            selected.append(remaining[best_idx])
            remaining.pop(best_idx)
        return selected

    def _cosine_sim(self, a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b) + 1e-10))

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"agent": "retrieval", "status": "healthy"}

src/tari/orchestrator/agents/outfit_agent.py
"""
Outfit Agent – composes coordinated looks using compatibility graph and constraints.
"""
import itertools
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Tuple
from collections import defaultdict
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ...body.pipeline import CirvannaOptimizedPipeline
from ...body.domain.body import BodySegment

class OutfitAgent:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self.body_pipeline = CirvannaOptimizedPipeline(config, cache, privacy_manager, pool)

    async def compose_outfits(self, products: List[Dict], intent: Dict,
                              user_profile: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Generate complete coordinated looks.
        """
        # Separate by category (inferred from metadata)
        categories = defaultdict(list)
        for p in products:
            cat = p.get("metadata", {}).get("category", "unknown")
            categories[cat].append(p)
        # Define category priority
        required_cats = ["top", "bottom", "footwear"]
        optional_cats = ["outerwear", "accessory", "bag"]
        # Generate outfit candidates
        outfits = []
        # For simplicity, take combinations of top, bottom, footwear
        tops = categories.get("top", [])[:5]
        bottoms = categories.get("bottom", [])[:5]
        footwear = categories.get("footwear", [])[:5]
        for top, bottom, shoe in itertools.product(tops, bottoms, footwear):
            outfit = {
                "outfit_id": f"outfit_{len(outfits)}",
                "items": [top, bottom, shoe],
                "compatibility_score": await self._compute_outfit_compatibility([top, bottom, shoe]),
                "aesthetic_profile": self._merge_aesthetics([top, bottom, shoe]),
                "color_palette": self._merge_colors([top, bottom, shoe]),
                "fit_scores": await self._compute_fit_scores([top, bottom, shoe], user_profile),
                "tension_tags": []
            }
            # Add optional items if available
            if categories.get("outerwear"):
                outer = categories["outerwear"][0]
                outfit["items"].append(outer)
                outfit["compatibility_score"] *= 0.9
            outfits.append(outfit)
        # Sort by compatibility
        outfits.sort(key=lambda x: x["compatibility_score"], reverse=True)
        # Apply constraints
        constrained = await self._apply_constraints(outfits, user_profile, intent)
        return constrained[:10]  # return top 10 outfits

    async def _compute_outfit_compatibility(self, items: List[Dict]) -> float:
        """Compute overall compatibility using pairwise scores."""
        if len(items) < 2:
            return 0.5
        total = 0.0
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(items)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(items)):
                emb_i = items[i].get("embedding")
                emb_j = items[j].get("embedding")
                if emb_i is not None and emb_j is not None:
                    sim = self._cosine_sim(emb_i, emb_j)
                else:
                    sim = 0.5
                total += sim
                count += 1
        return total / count if count > 0 else 0.5

    def _cosine_sim(self, a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(np.dot(a, b) / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b) + 1e-10))

    def _merge_aesthetics(self, items: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
        all_aesthetics = []
        for item in items:
            tags = item.get("metadata", {}).get("styleTags", [])
            all_aesthetics.extend(tags)
        # Return most common
        from collections import Counter
        return [tag for tag, _ in Counter(all_aesthetics).most_common(3)]

    def _merge_colors(self, items: List[Dict]) -> List[str]:
        all_colors = []
        for item in items:
            colors = item.get("metadata", {}).get("colors", [])
            all_colors.extend(colors)
        return list(set(all_colors))[:3]

    async def _compute_fit_scores(self, items: List[Dict], user_profile: Dict) -> Dict:
        # Use body calibration to estimate fit per item
        body_meas = user_profile.get("body_measurements", {})
        scores = {}
        for item in items:
            # Simplified: use similarity between item fit tags and user fit preferences
            fit_pref = user_profile.get("fitPreference", "regular")
            scores[item.get("product_id")] = 0.8 if fit_pref == "regular" else 0.6
        return scores

    async def _apply_constraints(self, outfits: List[Dict], user_profile: Dict, intent: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Apply constraint engine: category uniqueness, color coherence, layering rules, etc.
        """
        valid = []
        for outfit in outfits:
            # Category uniqueness (no duplicate categories)
            categories = [item.get("metadata", {}).get("category") for item in outfit["items"]]
            if len(set(categories)) != len(categories):
                continue
            # Color coherence (simple: at least two items share a color)
            all_colors = self._merge_colors(outfit["items"])
            if len(all_colors) < 1:
                continue
            # Layering rule: if outerwear, must have top and bottom
            has_outer = any(cat == "outerwear" for cat in categories)
            has_top = any(cat == "top" for cat in categories)
            has_bottom = any(cat == "bottom" for cat in categories)
            if has_outer and (not has_top or not has_bottom):
                continue
            # Seasonal rule (simplified)
            season = intent.get("season", "spring")
            if season == "winter" and not any(cat == "outerwear" for cat in categories):
                continue
            valid.append(outfit)
        return valid

    async def generate_variations(self, outfits: List[Dict], intent: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Generate slight variations of a selected look (darker, luxury, casual, avant-garde, warmer).
        """
        variations = []
        for outfit in outfits:
            base_items = outfit["items"]
            # For each item, generate a variant by replacing with similar but slightly different product
            # Placeholder: just copy the outfit with modified metadata
            variant = outfit.copy()
            variant["outfit_id"] = f"{outfit['outfit_id']}_variation"
            variant["variation_type"] = "luxury"
            variant["compatibility_score"] *= 0.95
            variations.append(variant)
        return variations

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"agent": "outfit", "status": "healthy"}

src/tari/orchestrator/agents/tryon_agent.py
"""
Try-On Agent – async queue for virtual try-on rendering.
"""
import asyncio
import uuid
import time
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool

class TryOnAgent:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self._job_queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self._workers = []
        self._render_cache = {}

    async def start(self):
        for _ in range(self.config.TRYON_GPU_WORKERS):
            worker = asyncio.create_task(self._worker_loop())
            self._workers.append(worker)

    async def queue_tryon(self, user_id: str, outfit: Dict, context: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Submit a try-on job to the async queue."""
        job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        resolution = self.config.FREE_TIER_TRYON_RESOLUTION
        if context.get("tier") == "premium":
            resolution = self.config.PREMIUM_TIER_TRYON_RESOLUTION
        job = {
            "job_id": job_id,
            "user_id": user_id,
            "outfit": outfit,
            "context": context,
            "resolution": resolution,
            "status": "queued",
            "created_at": time.time()
        }
        await self._job_queue.put(job)
        await self._store_job(job)
        return {"job_id": job_id, "status": "queued", "estimated_time_ms": self.config.MAX_TRYON_QUEUE_DELAY_MS}

    async def _worker_loop(self):
        while True:
            try:
                job = await self._job_queue.get()
                await self._process_job(job)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                break
            except Exception as e:
                job["status"] = "failed"
                job["error"] = str(e)
                await self._update_job(job)

    async def _process_job(self, job: Dict):
        job["status"] = "rendering"
        await self._update_job(job)
        # Simulate rendering (place – call actual try-on model)
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        # For simplicity, generate dummy image URL
        render_url = f"https://render.xyra.ai/{job['job_id']}.png"
        job["status"] = "completed"
        job["render_url"] = render_url
        job["completed_at"] = time.time()
        await self._update_job(job)
        # Cache result
        self._render_cache[job["job_id"]] = job

    async def get_result(self, job_id: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        if job_id in self._render_cache:
            return self._render_cache[job_id]
        # Check storage
        return await self._fetch_job(job_id)

    async def _store_job(self, job: Dict):
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            await redis_pool.setex(f"tryon_job:{job['job_id']}", 3600, orjson.dumps(job))

    async def _update_job(self, job: Dict):
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            await redis_pool.setex(f"tryon_job:{job['job_id']}", 3600, orjson.dumps(job))

    async def _fetch_job(self, job_id: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            data = await redis_pool.get(f"tryon_job:{job_id}")
            if data:
                return orjson.loads(data)
        return None

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"agent": "tryon", "queue_size": self._job_queue.qsize(), "workers": len(self._workers)}
```

"""
Learning Agent – XARI ranking engine, context bandit, feedback processing.
"""
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ...optimization.real_time_optimizer import RealTimeOptimizer

class LearningAgent:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self.optimizer = RealTimeOptimizer(config)
        self._user_bandits = {}  # user_id -> LinUCB model placeholder

    async def rank_outfits(self, outfits: List[Dict], user_id: str, context: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Rank outfits using XARI scoring function.
        """
        for outfit in outfits:
            score = self._compute_xari_score(outfit, user_id, context)
            outfit["xari_score"] = score
        outfits.sort(key=lambda x: x["xari_score"], reverse=True)
        return outfits

    def _compute_xari_score(self, outfit: Dict, user_id: str, context: Dict) -> float:
        """
        finalScore =
          semanticSimilarity * 0.30 +
          compatibilityScore * 0.25 +
          userPreferenceScore * 0.20 +
          noveltyScore * 0.10 +
          confidenceScore * 0.10 +
          diversityScore * 0.05
        """
        similarity = outfit.get("compatibility_score", 0.5)  # proxy for semantic similarity
        compatibility = outfit.get("compatibility_score", 0.5)
        user_pref = self._get_user_preference_score(user_id, outfit)
        novelty = self._compute_novelty(outfit)
        confidence = self._compute_confidence(outfit, context)
        diversity = self._compute_diversity(outfit)
        final = (self.config.RANKING_SIMILARITY_WEIGHT * similarity +
                 self.config.RANKING_COMPATIBILITY_WEIGHT * compatibility +
                 self.config.RANKING_USER_PREFERENCE_WEIGHT * user_pref +
                 self.config.RANKING_NOVELTY_WEIGHT * novelty +
                 self.config.RANKING_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHT * confidence +
                 self.config.RANKING_DIVERSITY_WEIGHT * diversity)
        return final

    def _get_user_preference_score(self, user_id: str, outfit: Dict) -> float:
        # Placeholder – query user profile for style affinity
        return 0.7

    def _compute_novelty(self, outfit: Dict) -> float:
        # Placeholder – how different is this from previously seen items
        return 0.5

    def _compute_confidence(self, outfit: Dict, context: Dict) -> float:
        # Use CRFP from context
        return context.get("CRFP_state", 0.8)

    def _compute_diversity(self, outfit: Dict) -> float:
        # Placeholder – within-outfit diversity
        return 0.5

    async def record_interaction(self, user_id: str, query: str, response: Dict, context: Dict):
        """
        Record user interaction for online learning.
        """
        # Placeholder – update bandit models, user preferences, etc.
        pass

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"agent": "learning", "status": "healthy"}

src/tari/orchestrator/memory/memory_service.py
"""
Memory Service – layered memory: session, preference, behavioral, semantic.
"""
import time
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
from collections import defaultdict
from ...config import TariConfig
from ...cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ...privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
from ...connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool

class MemoryService:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig, cache: PredictiveCache,
                 privacy_manager: PrivacyManager, pool: SecureConnectionPool):
        self.config = config
        self.cache = cache
        self.privacy_manager = privacy_manager
        self.pool = pool
        self._session_memories = defaultdict(dict)
        self._preferences = defaultdict(dict)
        self._behavioral = defaultdict(list)
        self._semantic_embeddings = defaultdict(list)

    async def get_user_profile(self, user_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Retrieve combined user profile from all memory tiers."""
        anonymized = self.privacy_manager.anonymize_user_id(user_id)
        # Fetch from Redis/Postgres or from local caches
        preferences = await self._get_preferences(anonymized)
        behavioral = await self._get_behavioral(anonymized)
        semantic = await self._get_semantic(anonymized)
        session = self._session_memories.get(anonymized, {})
        # Merge
        profile = {
            "likedStyles": preferences.get("liked_styles", []),
            "dislikedStyles": preferences.get("disliked_styles", []),
            "preferredColors": preferences.get("preferred_colors", []),
            "avoidedColors": preferences.get("avoided_colors", []),
            "luxuryPreference": preferences.get("luxury_preference", 0.5),
            "formalityPreference": preferences.get("formality_preference", 0.5),
            "silhouettePreferences": preferences.get("silhouette_preferences", []),
            "recentInteractions": behavioral[-10:],
            "semanticStyle": semantic.get("embedding", []),
            "session": session
        }
        return profile

    async def update_memory(self, user_id: str, interaction: Dict):
        """Update memory tiers based on interaction."""
        anonymized = self.privacy_manager.anonymize_user_id(user_id)
        # Session memory (short-term)
        self._session_memories[anonymized].update(interaction)
        # Preference memory (if explicit like/dislike)
        if "liked_style" in interaction:
            prefs = await self._get_preferences(anonymized)
            prefs["liked_styles"] = prefs.get("liked_styles", []) + [interaction["liked_style"]]
            await self._store_preferences(anonymized, prefs)
        # Behavioral memory (append)
        self._behavioral[anonymized].append({
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "type": interaction.get("type"),
            "product_id": interaction.get("product_id")
        })
        if len(self._behavioral[anonymized]) > 100:
            self._behavioral[anonymized] = self._behavioral[anonymized][-100:]
        # Semantic memory (update embedding with temporal decay)
        if "style_embedding" in interaction:
            emb = interaction["style_embedding"]
            current = await self._get_semantic(anonymized)
            old_emb = current.get("embedding", [0]*384)
            # Exponential moving average with decay
            alpha = 0.3
            new_emb = [alpha * e + (1-alpha) * o for e, o in zip(emb, old_emb)]
            await self._store_semantic(anonymized, {"embedding": new_emb})

    async def _get_preferences(self, user_id: str) -> Dict:
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            data = await redis_pool.get(f"preferences:{user_id}")
            if data:
                return orjson.loads(data)
        return {}

    async def _store_preferences(self, user_id: str, prefs: Dict):
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            await redis_pool.setex(f"preferences:{user_id}", 86400 * 30, orjson.dumps(prefs))

    async def _get_behavioral(self, user_id: str) -> List:
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            data = await redis_pool.lrange(f"behavioral:{user_id}", 0, -1)
            return [orjson.loads(d) for d in data]

    async def _get_semantic(self, user_id: str) -> Dict:
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            data = await redis_pool.get(f"semantic:{user_id}")
            if data:
                return orjson.loads(data)
        return {"embedding": []}

    async def _store_semantic(self, user_id: str, semantic: Dict):
        pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
        async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
            await redis_pool.setex(f"semantic:{user_id}", 86400 * 30, orjson.dumps(semantic))

    async def health(self) -> Dict:
        return {"service": "memory", "status": "healthy"}
```

src/tari/orchestrator/evaluation/offline_eval.py
"""
Offline evaluation framework for retrieval and outfit quality.
"""
import numpy as np
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from ...config import TariConfig

class OfflineEvaluator:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig):
        self.config = config

    def compute_recall_at_k(self, retrieved_ids: List[str], relevant_ids: List[str], k: int) -> float:
        retrieved_k = retrieved_ids[:k]
        intersection = set(retrieved_k) & set(relevant_ids)
        return len(intersection) / len(relevant_ids) if relevant_ids else 0.0

    def compute_ndcg_at_k(self, retrieved_ids: List[str], relevance_scores: Dict[str, float], k: int) -> float:
        dcg = 0.0
        for i, pid in enumerate(retrieved_ids[:k]):
            rel = relevance_scores.get(pid, 0.0)
            dcg += rel / np.log2(i + 2)
        # Ideal DCG
        sorted_relevances = sorted(relevance_scores.values(), reverse=True)[:k]
        idcg = sum([rel / np.log2(i + 2) for i, rel in enumerate(sorted_relevances)])
        return dcg / idcg if idcg > 0 else 0.0

    def compute_mrr(self, retrieved_ids: List[str], relevant_ids: List[str]) -> float:
        for i, pid in enumerate(retrieved_ids):
            if pid in relevant_ids:
                return 1.0 / (i + 1)
        return 0.0
```

"""
Online evaluation with A/B testing.
"""
import hashlib
import random
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional
from ...config import TariConfig

class OnlineExperimentManager:
    def __init__(self, config: TariConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.experiments = {
            "ranking_weights": ["control", "variant_a", "variant_b"],
            "diversity_lambda": ["control", "high_diversity", "low_diversity"]
        }

    def get_variant(self, user_id: str, experiment_name: str) -> str:
        if not self.config.ENABLE_AB_TESTING:
            return "control"
        variants = self.experiments.get(experiment_name, ["control"])
        hash_val = int(hashlib.md5(f"{user_id}:{experiment_name}".encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
        idx = hash_val % len(variants)
        return variants[idx]

    def record_conversion(self, user_id: str, experiment_name: str, variant: str, metric: str, value: float):
        # Log to analytics service
        pass

"""
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry.
"""
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.exporter.jaeger.thrift import JaegerExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from ...config import TariConfig

def init_tracing(config: TariConfig):
    if not config.ENABLE_DISTRIBUTED_TRACING:
        return
    provider = TracerProvider()
    exporter = JaegerExporter(
        agent_host_name="localhost",
        agent_port=6831,
    )
    provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))
    trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
    return trace.get_tracer("xyra.orchestrator")

src/tari/api/endpoints.py
"""
API endpoints for recommendations, dialogue, try-on, and marketplace.
"""
import time
import base64
import numpy as np
import cv2
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, File, UploadFile, Form
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, validator
from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Any

from ..config import TariConfig
from ..cache.predictive_cache import PredictiveCache
from ..recommendation.engine import PrivacyFirstRecommendationEngine
from ..orchestrator.gateway import XyraGatewayOrchestrator
from ..orchestrator.agents.tryon_agent import TryOnAgent
from ..middleware.security import security
from ..logging.metrics import METRICS

router = APIRouter()

class ConversationRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    query: str
    context: Dict = Field(default_factory=dict)

class TryOnStatusRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    job_id: str

# Dependencies
async def get_gateway():
    config = TariConfig()
    cache = PredictiveCache(config)
    from ..privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
    from ..connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
    privacy = PrivacyManager(config)
    pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
    gateway = XyraGatewayOrchestrator(config, cache, privacy, pool)
    return gateway

@router.post("/api/v6/converse")
async def converse(
    req: ConversationRequest,
    gateway: XyraGatewayOrchestrator = Depends(get_gateway),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)
):
    METRICS["active_requests"].inc()
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        result = await gateway.process(req.user_id, req.query, req.context)
        elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start_time) * 1000
        result["performance"] = {"elapsed_ms": elapsed_ms}
        return result
    except Exception as e:
        METRICS["error_rate"].labels(type=type(e).__name__, severity="high").inc()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        METRICS["active_requests"].dec()

@router.get("/api/v6/tryon/status/{job_id}")
async def get_tryon_status(
    job_id: str,
    user_id: str,
    gateway: XyraGatewayOrchestrator = Depends(get_gateway),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)
):
    result = await gateway.tryon_agent.get_result(job_id)
    if not result:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")
    return result

@router.post("/api/v6/tryon/render")
async def render_tryon(
    outfit: Dict,
    user_id: str,
    context: Dict,
    gateway: XyraGatewayOrchestrator = Depends(get_gateway),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)
):
    job = await gateway.tryon_agent.queue_tryon(user_id, outfit, context)
    return job

@router.post("/api/v6/feedback")
async def submit_feedback(
    user_id: str,
    interaction_type: str,
    product_id: str,
    rating: Optional[int] = None,
    gateway: XyraGatewayOrchestrator = Depends(get_gateway),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)
):
    await gateway.learning_agent.record_interaction(
        user_id, "", {"product_id": product_id}, {"feedback": rating}
    )
    await gateway.memory_service.update_memory(user_id, {
        "type": interaction_type,
        "product_id": product_id,
        "rating": rating
    })
    return {"status": "recorded"}

@router.get("/api/v6/health/detailed")
async def detailed_health(
    gateway: XyraGatewayOrchestrator = Depends(get_gateway),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)
):
    return await gateway.health_check()

src/tari/api/app.py
"""
Main FastAPI application with integrated lifespan.
"""
import os
import asyncio
import json
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.middleware.gzip import GZipMiddleware
import orjson
from ..config import TariConfig
from ..connection_pool import SecureConnectionPool
from ..middleware.security import SecurityMiddleware
from ..utils.warmup import warm_up_system, monitor_system_performance
from ..orchestrator.gateway import XyraGatewayOrchestrator
from ..orchestrator.agents.tryon_agent import TryOnAgent
from . import endpoints, health

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    config = TariConfig()
    pool = SecureConnectionPool.get_instance(config)
    try:
        await pool.initialize()
        # Initialize gateway and start try-on workers
        cache = PredictiveCache(config)
        from ..privacy.manager import PrivacyManager
        privacy = PrivacyManager(config)
        gateway = XyraGatewayOrchestrator(config, cache, privacy, pool)
        await gateway.tryon_agent.start()
        app.state.gateway = gateway
        if config.ENABLE_FACE_ANALYSIS or config.ENABLE_BODY_CALIBRATION:
            await warm_up_system(pool, config)
        monitoring_task = asyncio.create_task(monitor_system_performance())
        yield
        monitoring_task.cancel()
        try:
            await monitoring_task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass
        await pool.close()
    except Exception as e:
        raise

app = FastAPI(
    title="Xyra V6 - Full Fashion Intelligence System",
    version="6.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs" if not os.getenv("PRODUCTION") else None,
    redoc_url=None,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=json.loads(os.getenv("ALLOWED_ORIGINS", '["*"]')),
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.add_middleware(GZipMiddleware, minimum_size=1000)

security_middleware = SecurityMiddleware(TariConfig())
app.middleware("http")(security_middleware)

@app.middleware("http")
async def deduplication_middleware(request, call_next):
    if request.method != "POST":
        return await call_next(request)
    import hashlib
    body = await request.body()
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(
        f"{request.url.path}:{body}".encode()
    ).hexdigest()
    cache_key = f"req_dedup:{fingerprint}"
    pool = await SecureConnectionPool.get_instance()
    async with pool.get_redis() as redis_pool:
        cached = await redis_pool.get(cache_key)
        if cached:
            return JSONResponse(orjson.loads(cached))
        response = await call_next(request)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            await redis_pool.setex(
                cache_key,
                2,
                orjson.dumps({
                    "status": response.status_code,
                    "body": response.body.decode() if hasattr(response.body, 'decode') else str(response.body)
                })
            )
        return response

app.include_router(endpoints.router)
app.include_router(health.router)

README.md
# Xyra V6 – Full Fashion Intelligence System

Xyra is a unified platform integrating:
- **Conversational AI** (intent parsing, multi-turn dialogue)
- **Semantic Product Retrieval** (hybrid search: BM25 + vectors + behavioral boost)
- **Outfit Composition** (compatibility graph, constraints, variations)
- **XARI Ranking Engine** (contextual bandit, multi‑objective scoring)
- **Virtual Try‑On** (async GPU rendering, queue management)
- **Layered Memory** (session, preference, behavioral, semantic)
- **Fashion Knowledge Graph** (relational style reasoning)
- **Observability** (distributed tracing, metrics, A/B testing)

## Architecture

```

User Prompt → Gateway Orchestrator → Agents:

· Conversation → Intent parsing, clarification
· Retrieval → Vector search + BM25 + reranking
· Outfit → Composition, constraints, variations
· XARI Ranking → Multi‑objective scoring
· Try‑On → Async rendering queue
· Learning → Online bandit updates
  Memory Service + Knowledge Graph → Personalization

```

## Quick Start

```bash
docker-compose up -d
```

API Endpoints

· POST /api/v6/converse – natural language styling conversation
· GET /api/v6/tryon/status/{job_id} – check try‑on rendering status
· POST /api/v6/tryon/render – queue a try‑on job
· POST /api/v6/feedback – record user feedback
· GET /api/v6/health/detailed – system health

Configuration

See TariConfig in config.py.

License

Proprietary – Cirvanna.

```

# src/core/domain/entities.py
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Set, Optional, Dict, Any
from uuid import UUID
import numpy as np

@dataclass
class Vector:
    values: np.ndarray

    def cosine_similarity(self, other: 'Vector') -> float:
        norm = np.linalg.norm(self.values) * np.linalg.norm(other.values)
        return float(np.dot(self.values, other.values) / norm) if norm != 0 else 0.0

    def to_list(self) -> List[float]:
        return self.values.tolist()

@dataclass
class ItemFeatures:
    color: str = 'unknown'
    material: str = 'unknown'
    style_tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    pattern: Optional[str] = None
    silhouette: Optional[str] = None
    formality: float = 0.5
    trendiness: float = 0.5
    versatility: float = 0.5
    thermal_rating: float = 0.5
    water_resistance: float = 0.0
    uv_protection: float = 0.0
    breathability: float = 0.5
    wind_resistance: float = 0.0
    brand: str = 'unknown'

@dataclass
class Item:
    item_id: UUID
    category: str
    features: ItemFeatures
    embedding: Vector
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    revival_score: float = 0.5
    trend_score: float = 0.5
    climate_compatibility: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    confidence: float = 0.8
    thermal_rating: float = 0.5
    water_resistance: float = 0.0
    uv_protection: float = 0.0
    breathability: float = 0.5
    wind_resistance: float = 0.0
    brand: str = 'unknown'

@dataclass
class UserProfile:
    user_id: UUID
    style_vector: Vector
    archetype: str
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    negative_preferences: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    cultural_constraints: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    location: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None
    style_history: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    engagement_rate: float = 0.5
    exploration_rate: float = 0.5
    body_measurements: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None

@dataclass
class FeedbackEvent:
    event_id: UUID
    user_id: UUID
    item_id: UUID
    event_type: str
    timestamp: datetime
    context: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    recency_weight: float = 1.0
    engagement_weight: float = 1.0
    effective_weight: float = 1.0

    @property
    def base_weight(self) -> float:
        weights = {
            'purchase': 1.0,
            'save': 0.7,
            'tryon': 0.6,
            'view': 0.3,
            'skip': -0.2
        }
        return weights.get(self.event_type, 0.0)

@dataclass
class CulturalTrend:
    trend_id: UUID
    name: str
    embedding: Vector
    confidence: float
    created_at: datetime
    expires_at: datetime

@dataclass
class SegmentPrior:
    segment_id: str
    embedding: np.ndarray
    confidence: float
    variance: float
    last_updated: datetime
    sample_size: int

@dataclass
class StyleSnapshot:
    user_id: UUID
    timestamp: datetime
    dominant_style_embedding: List[float]
    confidence_trend: float
    revival_trend: float
```

# src/core/ports/repository.py
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from uuid import UUID

from src.core.domain.entities import UserProfile, Item, FeedbackEvent, CulturalTrend, SegmentPrior, StyleSnapshot

class UserRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_user(self, user_id: UUID) -> Optional[UserProfile]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def save_user(self, user: UserProfile) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, entity_id: UUID) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_users_by_archetype(self, archetype: str, limit: int = 100) -> List[UserProfile]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_user_vector(self, user_id: UUID, vector: Any) -> None:
        pass


class ItemRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_item(self, item_id: UUID) -> Optional[Item]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def save_item(self, item: Item) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete(self, entity_id: UUID) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_items_by_category(self, category: str, limit: int = 100) -> List[Item]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def find_similar_items(self, vector: Any, limit: int = 100) -> List[Item]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_trending_items(self, limit: int = 100) -> List[Item]:
        pass


class FeedbackRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def save_feedback(self, event: FeedbackEvent) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_recent_for_item(self, user_id: UUID, item_id: UUID, minutes: int) -> List[FeedbackEvent]:
        pass


class TrendRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_current_trends(self, limit: int = 100) -> List[CulturalTrend]:
        pass


class SegmentPriorRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_prior(self, segment_id: str) -> Optional[SegmentPrior]:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_prior(self, prior: SegmentPrior) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def apply_inactivity_decay(self, days_threshold: int = 30, decay_factor: float = 0.95):
        pass


class StyleSnapshotRepository(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    async def save(self, snapshot: StyleSnapshot) -> None:
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_for_user(self, user_id: UUID, limit: int = 52) -> List[StyleSnapshot]:
        pass
