services/item-service/app/db.py

```python
"""Async SQLAlchemy engine and session factory."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncEngine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
    create_async_engine,
)

from common.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_engine: AsyncEngine | None = None
_session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None


def get_engine() -> AsyncEngine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        _engine = create_async_engine(
            settings.database_url,
            pool_size=settings.database_pool_size,
            max_overflow=settings.database_max_overflow,
            pool_pre_ping=True,
            pool_recycle=3600,
            echo=settings.database_echo,
            future=True,
        )
        logger.info("Database engine created")
    return _engine


def get_session_factory() -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
    global _session_factory
    if _session_factory is None:
        _session_factory = async_sessionmaker(
            get_engine(), class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False, autoflush=False
        )
    return _session_factory


async def get_session() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    """FastAPI dependency yielding a request-scoped session."""
    factory = get_session_factory()
    async with factory() as session:
        try:
            yield session
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise


async def dispose_engine() -> None:
    global _engine, _session_factory
    if _engine is not None:
        await _engine.dispose()
        _engine = None
        _session_factory = None
        logger.info("Database engine disposed")
```

services/item-service/app/models.py

```python
"""SQLAlchemy ORM models + Pydantic request/response schemas."""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import uuid
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, Float, Index, Integer, String, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column

from common.domain import (
    GeometryProfile,
    IngestionMethod,
    PrimaryCategory,
    SurfaceProperties,
    WardrobeObject,
)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class ItemRow(Base):
    """Persistent representation of a WardrobeObject."""

    __tablename__ = "items"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True)
    owner_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True, nullable=False)
    ingestion_method: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    primary_category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), index=True, nullable=False)
    bootstrap_confidence: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    geometry_profile: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    surface_properties: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    category_constraints: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    wearability_context: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    confidence_envelope: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    regret_signals: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    lifecycle_state: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), index=True, nullable=False)
    total_wears: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    successful_wears: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    adaptive_slice_weight: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    pending_decay_days: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    catalog_metadata: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False, default=dict)
    created_at: Mapped[dt.datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
    updated_at: Mapped[dt.datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now()
    )
    last_worn: Mapped[dt.datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_items_owner_category", "owner_id", "primary_category"),
        Index("ix_items_owner_state", "owner_id", "lifecycle_state"),
    )

    @classmethod
    def from_domain(cls, obj: WardrobeObject) -> "ItemRow":
        return cls(
            id=obj.id,
            owner_id=obj.owner_id,
            ingestion_method=obj.ingestion_method.value,
            primary_category=obj.category_constraints["primary_category"],
            bootstrap_confidence=obj.bootstrap_confidence,
            geometry_profile=obj.geometry_profile.to_dict() if obj.geometry_profile else None,
            surface_properties=obj.surface_properties.to_dict() if obj.surface_properties else None,
            category_constraints=obj.category_constraints,
            wearability_context=obj.wearability_context,
            confidence_envelope=obj.confidence_envelope.to_dict(),
            regret_signals=obj.regret_signals.to_dict(),
            lifecycle_state=obj.lifecycle_state.value,
            total_wears=obj.total_wears,
            successful_wears=obj.successful_wears,
            adaptive_slice_weight=obj.adaptive_slice_weight,
            pending_decay_days=obj.pending_decay_days,
            catalog_metadata=obj._catalog_metadata,
            created_at=obj.created_at,
            updated_at=obj.last_updated,
            last_worn=obj.last_worn,
        )

    def to_domain(self) -> WardrobeObject:
        obj = WardrobeObject.from_dict(
            {
                "id": self.id,
                "owner_id": self.owner_id,
                "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
                "last_updated": self.updated_at.isoformat(),
                "ingestion_method": self.ingestion_method,
                "lifecycle_state": self.lifecycle_state,
                "bootstrap_confidence": self.bootstrap_confidence,
                "geometry_profile": self.geometry_profile,
                "surface_properties": self.surface_properties,
                "category_constraints": self.category_constraints,
                "wearability_context": self.wearability_context,
                "confidence_envelope": self.confidence_envelope,
                "regret_signals": self.regret_signals,
                "usage_history": [],
                "total_wears": self.total_wears,
                "successful_wears": self.successful_wears,
                "adaptive_slice_weight": self.adaptive_slice_weight,
                "pending_decay_days": self.pending_decay_days,
                "catalog_metadata": self.catalog_metadata,
                "last_worn": self.last_worn.isoformat() if self.last_worn else None,
            }
        )
        return obj


class WearEventRow(Base):
    __tablename__ = "wear_events"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    item_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), index=True, nullable=False)
    owner_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True, nullable=False)
    accepted: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False)
    duration_minutes: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=False)
    event_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    context_snapshot: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    timestamp: Mapped[dt.datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), index=True)


# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pydantic schemas
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class GeometryData(BaseModel):
    silhouette_class: str
    length_profile: str
    volume_distribution: list[float]
    stretch_behavior: str

    @field_validator("volume_distribution")
    @classmethod
    def _check_volume(cls, v: list[float]) -> list[float]:
        if len(v) != 3 or any(x < 0 or x > 1 for x in v) or abs(sum(v) - 1.0) > 0.01:
            raise ValueError("volume_distribution must be 3 non-negative values summing to 1.0")
        return v


class SurfaceData(BaseModel):
    dominant_color: dict[str, float]
    color_variance: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    texture_class: str
    pattern_density: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    lighting_risk: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class ItemCreate(BaseModel):
    owner_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    ingestion_method: str
    primary_category: str
    bootstrap_confidence: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    geometry_data: GeometryData | None = None
    surface_data: SurfaceData | None = None
    catalog_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    @field_validator("ingestion_method")
    @classmethod
    def _check_ingestion(cls, v: str) -> str:
        if v not in [m.value for m in IngestionMethod]:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid ingestion_method: {v}")
        return v

    @field_validator("primary_category")
    @classmethod
    def _check_category(cls, v: str) -> str:
        if v not in [c.value for c in PrimaryCategory]:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid primary_category: {v}")
        return v


class WearRequest(BaseModel):
    accepted: bool
    duration_minutes: float = Field(gt=0, le=1440)
    event_type: str = "wear"
    context_snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None = None


class ItemSummary(BaseModel):
    id: str
    owner_id: str
    primary_category: str
    lifecycle_state: str
    confidence: float
    total_wears: int
    last_worn: dt.datetime | None = None


class ItemListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[ItemSummary]
    total: int
    skip: int
    limit: int
```

services/item-service/app/repositories.py

```python
"""Repository layer — the only place that touches the DB."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Sequence

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from .models import ItemRow, WearEventRow

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ItemRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def insert(self, row: ItemRow) -> ItemRow:
        self.session.add(row)
        await self.session.flush()
        return row

    async def get(self, item_id: str) -> ItemRow | None:
        stmt = select(ItemRow).where(ItemRow.id == item_id)
        return (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()

    async def list_by_owner(
        self, owner_id: str, skip: int, limit: int, category: str | None = None
    ) -> Sequence[ItemRow]:
        stmt = select(ItemRow).where(ItemRow.owner_id == owner_id)
        if category:
            stmt = stmt.where(ItemRow.primary_category == category)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(ItemRow.created_at.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        return (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()

    async def count_by_owner(self, owner_id: str, category: str | None = None) -> int:
        stmt = select(func.count(ItemRow.id)).where(ItemRow.owner_id == owner_id)
        if category:
            stmt = stmt.where(ItemRow.primary_category == category)
        return int((await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalar() or 0)

    async def update(self, row: ItemRow) -> ItemRow:
        merged = await self.session.merge(row)
        await self.session.flush()
        return merged

    async def delete(self, item_id: str) -> bool:
        stmt = delete(ItemRow).where(ItemRow.id == item_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.rowcount > 0

    async def list_all_for_owner(self, owner_id: str) -> Sequence[ItemRow]:
        stmt = select(ItemRow).where(ItemRow.owner_id == owner_id)
        return (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()

    async def increment_wear_counters(self, item_id: str, accepted: bool) -> None:
        stmt = (
            update(ItemRow)
            .where(ItemRow.id == item_id)
            .values(
                total_wears=ItemRow.total_wears + 1,
                successful_wears=ItemRow.successful_wears + (1 if accepted else 0),
                updated_at=func.now(),
            )
        )
        await self.session.execute(stmt)


class WearRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def insert(self, row: WearEventRow) -> WearEventRow:
        self.session.add(row)
        await self.session.flush()
        return row

    async def list_for_item(self, item_id: str, limit: int = 100) -> Sequence[WearEventRow]:
        stmt = (
            select(WearEventRow)
            .where(WearEventRow.item_id == item_id)
            .order_by(WearEventRow.timestamp.desc())
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()
```

services/item-service/app/services.py

```python
"""Item service business logic."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import uuid

from common.cache import RedisCache
from common.domain import (
    ColorVector,
    EventType,
    GeometryProfile,
    IngestionMethod,
    PrimaryCategory,
    SilhouetteClass,
    SurfaceProperties,
    TextureClass,
    WardrobeObject,
)
from common.errors import NotFoundError, ValidationError
from common.events import EventPublisher

from .config import CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
from .models import (
    GeometryData,
    ItemCreate,
    ItemRow,
    ItemSummary,
    SurfaceData,
    WearEventRow,
    WearRequest,
)
from .repositories import ItemRepository, WearRepository

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ItemService:
    """Orchestrates domain objects, persistence, cache, and events."""

    def __init__(self, item_repo: ItemRepository, wear_repo: WearRepository) -> None:
        self.items = item_repo
        self.wears = wear_repo

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Create
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async def create(self, payload: ItemCreate) -> WardrobeObject:
        domain = WardrobeObject(
            owner_id=payload.owner_id,
            ingestion_method=IngestionMethod(payload.ingestion_method),
            primary_category=PrimaryCategory(payload.primary_category),
            bootstrap_confidence=payload.bootstrap_confidence,
        )

        if payload.geometry_data:
            domain.geometry_profile = self._build_geometry(payload.geometry_data)
        if payload.surface_data:
            domain.surface_properties = self._build_surface(payload.surface_data)
        if payload.catalog_metadata:
            domain.catalog_metadata = payload.catalog_metadata

        row = ItemRow.from_domain(domain)
        await self.items.insert(row)

        await EventPublisher.publish(
            "item.created",
            {
                "item_id": domain.id,
                "owner_id": domain.owner_id,
                "primary_category": domain.category_constraints["primary_category"],
            },
        )
        logger.info(f"Created item {domain.id} for owner {domain.owner_id}")
        return domain

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Read
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async def get(self, item_id: str, *, use_cache: bool = True) -> WardrobeObject:
        cache_key = f"item:{item_id}"
        if use_cache:
            cached = await RedisCache.get_json(cache_key)
            if cached:
                return WardrobeObject.from_dict(cached)

        row = await self.items.get(item_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"Item {item_id} not found")

        domain = row.to_domain()
        if use_cache:
            await RedisCache.set_json(cache_key, domain.to_dict(), ttl=CACHE_TTL_SECONDS)
        return domain

    async def list_for_owner(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 20,
        category: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[list[ItemSummary], int]:
        rows = await self.items.list_by_owner(owner_id, skip, limit, category)
        total = await self.items.count_by_owner(owner_id, category)
        summaries = [
            ItemSummary(
                id=r.id,
                owner_id=r.owner_id,
                primary_category=r.primary_category,
                lifecycle_state=r.lifecycle_state,
                confidence=r.confidence_envelope.get("geometry_confidence", 0.0),
                total_wears=r.total_wears,
                last_worn=r.last_worn,
            )
            for r in rows
        ]
        return summaries, total

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Update
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    async def record_wear(self, item_id: str, payload: WearRequest) -> WardrobeObject:
        row = await self.items.get(item_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"Item {item_id} not found")

        domain = row.to_domain()

        # Atomic domain mutation
        domain.record_wear_event(
            accepted=payload.accepted,
            duration_estimate=payload.duration_minutes,
            event_type=EventType(payload.event_type),
            context_snapshot_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
        )

        # Persist updated aggregate
        await self.items.update(ItemRow.from_domain(domain))

        # Persist event log
        await self.wears.insert(
            WearEventRow(
                item_id=item_id,
                owner_id=row.owner_id,
                accepted=payload.accepted,
                duration_minutes=payload.duration_minutes,
                event_type=payload.event_type,
                context_snapshot=payload.context_snapshot,
            )
        )

        await RedisCache.delete(f"item:{item_id}")
        await EventPublisher.publish(
            "wear.recorded",
            {
                "item_id": item_id,
                "owner_id": row.owner_id,
                "accepted": payload.accepted,
                "duration_minutes": payload.duration_minutes,
                "event_type": payload.event_type,
            },
        )
        logger.info(f"Recorded {payload.event_type} for {item_id} accepted={payload.accepted}")
        return domain

    async def retire(self, item_id: str) -> None:
        row = await self.items.get(item_id)
        if row is None:
            raise NotFoundError(f"Item {item_id} not found")
        domain = row.to_domain()
        domain.retire()
        await self.items.update(ItemRow.from_domain(domain))
        await RedisCache.delete(f"item:{item_id}")
        await EventPublisher.publish("item.retired", {"item_id": item_id})

    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Helpers
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    @staticmethod
    def _build_geometry(data: GeometryData) -> GeometryProfile:
        try:
            return GeometryProfile(
                silhouette_class=SilhouetteClass(data.silhouette_class),
                length_profile=data.length_profile,
                volume_distribution=data.volume_distribution,
                stretch_behavior=data.stretch_behavior,
            )
        except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise ValidationError(f"Invalid geometry data: {exc}")

    @staticmethod
    def _build_surface(data: SurfaceData) -> SurfaceProperties:
        try:
            return SurfaceProperties(
                dominant_color=ColorVector.from_dict(data.dominant_color),
                color_variance=data.color_variance,
                texture_class=TextureClass(data.texture_class),
                pattern_density=data.pattern_density,
                lighting_risk=data.lighting_risk,
            )
        except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise ValidationError(f"Invalid surface data: {exc}")
```

services/item-service/app/main.py

```python
"""FastAPI application entrypoint."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Query, Request, status
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator
from slowapi.errors import RateLimitExceeded
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from common.cache import RedisCache
from common.config import settings
from common.errors import CirvannaError, NotFoundError
from common.events import EventPublisher
from common.logging_config import configure_logging
from common.security import correlation_middleware, current_user, limiter
from common.telemetry import setup_telemetry

from .config import MAX_LIST_LIMIT, SERVICE_NAME
from .db import dispose_engine, get_session
from .models import (
    Base,
    ItemCreate,
    ItemListResponse,
    ItemRow,
    ItemSummary,
    WearRequest,
)
from .repositories import ItemRepository, WearRepository
from .services import ItemService

configure_logging(SERVICE_NAME, settings.log_level, settings.log_format)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    from .db import get_engine

    async with get_engine().begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    await RedisCache.init()
    await EventPublisher.init()
    logger.info("Item service started")
    yield
    await EventPublisher.close()
    await RedisCache.close()
    await dispose_engine()
    logger.info("Item service stopped")


app = FastAPI(
    title="Cirvanna Item Service",
    version="3.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan,
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc",
)
app.state.limiter = limiter
app.middleware("http")(correlation_middleware)
setup_telemetry(app, SERVICE_NAME)
Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app, endpoint="/metrics", include_in_schema=False)


@app.exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded)
async def _rl_handler(request: Request, exc: RateLimitExceeded) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=429, content={"error": "rate_limit_exceeded"})


@app.exception_handler(CirvannaError)
async def _domain_err_handler(request: Request, exc: CirvannaError) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=exc.to_dict())


def get_item_service(session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)]) -> ItemService:
    return ItemService(ItemRepository(session), WearRepository(session))


ItemSvc = Annotated[ItemService, Depends(get_item_service)]
CurrentUser = Annotated[str, Depends(current_user)]


@app.get("/health", include_in_schema=False)
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok", "service": SERVICE_NAME}


@app.get("/ready", include_in_schema=False)
async def ready() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ready"}


@app.post("/items", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
@limiter.limit("60/minute")
async def create_item(
    request: Request, payload: ItemCreate, svc: ItemSvc, user: CurrentUser
) -> dict:
    domain = await svc.create(payload)
    return domain.to_dict()


@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
async def get_item(item_id: str, svc: ItemSvc, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    return (await svc.get(item_id)).to_dict()


@app.get("/items", response_model=ItemListResponse)
async def list_items(
    svc: ItemSvc,
    user: CurrentUser,
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=MAX_LIST_LIMIT),
    category: str | None = None,
) -> ItemListResponse:
    items, total = await svc.list_for_owner(user, skip, limit, category)
    return ItemListResponse(items=items, total=total, skip=skip, limit=limit)


@app.post("/items/{item_id}/wear", status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)
@limiter.limit("100/minute")
async def record_wear(
    request: Request, item_id: str, payload: WearRequest, svc: ItemSvc, user: CurrentUser
) -> dict:
    domain = await svc.record_wear(item_id, payload)
    return {"status": "accepted", "total_wears": domain.total_wears}


@app.delete("/items/{item_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def retire_item(item_id: str, svc: ItemSvc, user: CurrentUser) -> None:
    await svc.retire(item_id)


@app.post("/admin/seed")
async def seed_demo(svc: ItemSvc, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    """Create 20 demo items for the current user."""
    cats = ["top", "bottom", "outerwear", "footwear", "accessory"]
    created = 0
    for i in range(20):
        await svc.create(
            ItemCreate(
                owner_id=user,
                ingestion_method="manual",
                primary_category=cats[i % len(cats)],
                bootstrap_confidence=0.15,
            )
        )
        created += 1
    return {"created": created}
```

services/item-service/tests/test_domain.py

```python
"""Unit tests for pure domain logic (no I/O)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from common.domain import (
    ColorVector,
    ConfidenceEnvelope,
    EventType,
    GeometryProfile,
    IngestionMethod,
    LifecycleState,
    PrimaryCategory,
    RegretSignals,
    SilhouetteClass,
    TemporalValue,
    WardrobeObject,
)


class TestColorVector:
    def test_rgb_to_lab_black(self):
        c = ColorVector.from_rgb(0, 0, 0)
        assert c.l == 0
        assert -1 < c.a < 1 and -1 < c.b < 1

    def test_rgb_to_lab_white(self):
        c = ColorVector.from_rgb(255, 255, 255)
        assert c.l == pytest.approx(100, abs=1)
        assert abs(c.a) < 1 and abs(c.b) < 1

    def test_hex_roundtrip(self):
        c = ColorVector.from_hex("#ff8800")
        r, g, b = c.to_rgb()
        assert (r, g, b) == (255, 136, 0)

    def test_distance_identity(self):
        a = ColorVector.from_rgb(100, 100, 100)
        b = ColorVector.from_rgb(100, 100, 100)
        assert a.distance_to(b) == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-6)

    def test_serialization(self):
        c = ColorVector.from_rgb(50, 100, 150)
        c2 = ColorVector.from_dict(c.to_dict())
        assert c2.l == c.l and c2.a == c.a and c2.b == c.b


class TestTemporalValue:
    def test_smoothing(self):
        tv = TemporalValue(current=0.0, smoothing_factor=0.5)
        tv.update(1.0)
        assert tv.current == 1.0
        tv.update(1.0)
        assert tv.current == pytest.approx(1.0)

    def test_decay(self):
        tv = TemporalValue(current=1.0)
        tv.apply_decay(0.9)
        assert tv.current == pytest.approx(0.9)

    def test_trend_flat(self):
        tv = TemporalValue()
        for _ in range(5):
            tv.update(0.5)
        assert tv.get_trend() == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-6)


class TestConfidenceEnvelope:
    def test_ceiling_enforced(self):
        env = ConfidenceEnvelope(ingestion_method=IngestionMethod.MANUAL)
        env.update(geometry_confidence=0.99)
        assert env.geometry_confidence <= 0.35

    def test_overall_is_min(self):
        env = ConfidenceEnvelope(ingestion_method=IngestionMethod.CAMERA)
        env.update(
            geometry_confidence=0.5,
            surface_confidence=0.3,
            category_confidence=0.55,
            context_confidence=0.5,
        )
        assert env.overall_confidence == 0.3

    def test_decay(self):
        env = ConfidenceEnvelope(
            geometry_confidence=1.0,
            surface_confidence=1.0,
            category_confidence=1.0,
            context_confidence=1.0,
        )
        env.decay(30)
        assert env.geometry_confidence < 1.0


class TestWardrobeObject:
    def test_creation(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP)
        assert o.owner_id == "u1"
        assert o.lifecycle_state == LifecycleState.PROVISIONAL

    def test_wear_increases_confidence(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP, 0.2)
        before = o.confidence_envelope.overall_confidence
        o.record_wear_event(accepted=True, duration_estimate=120)
        assert o.confidence_envelope.overall_confidence >= before
        assert o.total_wears == 1 and o.successful_wears == 1

    def test_rejection_accumulates_regret(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP)
        o.record_wear_event(accepted=False, duration_estimate=10)
        assert o.regret_signals.get_weighted_regret() > 0

    def test_lifecycle_transition(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP, 0.2)
        for _ in range(5):
            o.record_wear_event(accepted=True, duration_estimate=120)
        assert o.lifecycle_state in (LifecycleState.ACTIVE_LEARNING, LifecycleState.STABLE)

    def test_retire(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP)
        o.retire()
        assert o.lifecycle_state == LifecycleState.RETIRED
        assert not o.get_safe_for_exploration()

    def test_serialization_roundtrip(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.CAMERA, PrimaryCategory.BOTTOM, 0.15)
        o.record_wear_event(accepted=True, duration_estimate=60)
        d = o.to_dict()
        o2 = WardrobeObject.from_dict(d)
        assert o2.id == o.id
        assert o2.total_wears == 1
        assert o2.ingestion_method == IngestionMethod.CAMERA

    def test_catalog_metadata_size_guard(self):
        o = WardrobeObject("u1", IngestionMethod.MANUAL, PrimaryCategory.TOP)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            o.catalog_metadata = {"data": "x" * 200_000}
```

services/graph-service/app/repository.py

```python
"""Neo4j repository — the only place Cypher is written."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from neo4j import AsyncGraphDatabase, AsyncDriver, AsyncSession

from common.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class GraphRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.driver: AsyncDriver = AsyncGraphDatabase.driver(
            settings.neo4j_uri,
            auth=(settings.neo4j_user, settings.neo4j_password.get_secret_value()),
            max_connection_pool_size=settings.neo4j_max_pool_size,
        )

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self.driver.close()

    async def verify_connectivity(self) -> None:
        await self.driver.verify_connectivity()

    async def ensure_constraints(self) -> None:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            await s.run("CREATE CONSTRAINT item_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (i:Item) REQUIRE i.id IS UNIQUE")
            await s.run(
                "CREATE CONSTRAINT user_id IF NOT EXISTS FOR (u:User) REQUIRE u.id IS UNIQUE"
            )

    async def upsert_item(self, item_id: str, owner_id: str, category: str) -> None:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            await s.run(
                """
                MERGE (u:User {id: $owner})
                MERGE (i:Item {id: $id})
                SET i.category = $cat, i.owner_id = $owner
                MERGE (u)-[:OWNS]->(i)
                """,
                id=item_id, owner=owner_id, cat=category,
            )

    async def create_edge(
        self, from_id: str, to_id: str, weight: float, confidence: float
    ) -> None:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            await s.run(
                """
                MATCH (a:Item {id: $f}), (b:Item {id: $t})
                MERGE (a)-[r:COMPATIBLE_WITH]->(b)
                SET r.weight = $w, r.confidence = $c, r.updated_at = datetime()
                """,
                f=from_id, t=to_id, w=weight, c=confidence,
            )

    async def get_compatible(
        self, item_id: str, min_confidence: float, limit: int
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            result = await s.run(
                """
                MATCH (a:Item {id: $id})-[r:COMPATIBLE_WITH]->(b:Item)
                WHERE r.confidence >= $mc
                RETURN b.id AS id, b.category AS category,
                       r.weight AS weight, r.confidence AS confidence
                ORDER BY r.weight DESC
                LIMIT $l
                """,
                id=item_id, mc=min_confidence, l=limit,
            )
            return [dict(rec) async for rec in result]

    async def decay_and_prune(self, days: int, prune_below: float) -> int:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            result = await s.run(
                """
                MATCH ()-[r:COMPATIBLE_WITH]->()
                SET r.weight = r.weight * ($decay ^ ($d / 30.0))
                WITH r WHERE r.weight < $th
                DELETE r
                RETURN count(r) AS removed
                """,
                decay=0.97, d=days, th=prune_below,
            )
            record = await result.single()
            return int(record["removed"]) if record else 0

    async def stats(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        async with self.driver.session() as s:
            r = await s.run("MATCH (i:Item) RETURN count(i) AS items")
            items = (await r.single())["items"]
            r = await s.run("MATCH ()-[e:COMPATIBLE_WITH]->() RETURN count(e) AS edges")
            edges = (await r.single())["edges"]
            return {"items": int(items), "edges": int(edges)}
```

services/graph-service/app/seeder.py

```python
"""Seeds and incrementally updates graph edges from item data."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging

import httpx

from common.domain import (
    PrimaryCategory,
    WardrobeObject,
    categories_are_compatible,
    rule_based_compatibility,
)

from .config import ITEM_SERVICE_URL
from .repository import GraphRepository

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class GraphSeeder:
    def __init__(self, repo: GraphRepository) -> None:
        self.repo = repo

    async def seed_from_items(self, items: list[WardrobeObject]) -> int:
        for it in items:
            await self.repo.upsert_item(
                it.id, it.owner_id, it.category_constraints["primary_category"]
            )

        coros = []
        for i, a in enumerate(items):
            for b in items[i + 1:]:
                if categories_are_compatible(a, b):
                    w = rule_based_compatibility(a, b)
                    coros.append(self.repo.create_edge(a.id, b.id, w, 0.15))
                    coros.append(self.repo.create_edge(b.id, a.id, w, 0.15))
        if coros:
            await asyncio.gather(*coros)
        logger.info(f"Seeded edges for {len(items)} items ({len(coros)} edges)")
        return len(coros)

    async def update_for_item(self, item_id: str) -> int:
        """Recompute edges for one item against its owner's other items."""
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
            r = await client.get(f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items/{item_id}")
            if r.status_code != 200:
                logger.warning(f"Item {item_id} not found for edge update")
                return 0
            item = WardrobeObject.from_dict(r.json())

            r = await client.get(
                f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items",
                params={"skip": 0, "limit": 500},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            others = [
                WardrobeObject.from_dict(x)
                for x in r.json()["items"]
                if x["id"] != item_id
            ]

        await self.repo.upsert_item(
            item.id, item.owner_id, item.category_constraints["primary_category"]
        )

        coros = []
        for o in others:
            if categories_are_compatible(item, o):
                w = rule_based_compatibility(item, o)
                coros.append(self.repo.create_edge(item.id, o.id, w, 0.3))
                coros.append(self.repo.create_edge(o.id, item.id, w, 0.3))
        if coros:
            await asyncio.gather(*coros)
        logger.info(f"Updated {len(coros)} edges for item {item_id}")
        return len(coros)
```

services/graph-service/app/main.py

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Query, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator

from common.config import settings
from common.errors import CirvannaError
from common.events import EventConsumer
from common.logging_config import configure_logging
from common.security import correlation_middleware, current_user
from common.telemetry import setup_telemetry

from .config import DEFAULT_LIMIT, DEFAULT_MIN_CONFIDENCE, EDGE_PRUNE_THRESHOLD, SERVICE_NAME
from .repository import GraphRepository
from .seeder import GraphSeeder

configure_logging(SERVICE_NAME, settings.log_level, settings.log_format)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    repo = GraphRepository()
    await repo.verify_connectivity()
    await repo.ensure_constraints()
    seeder = GraphSeeder(repo)
    app.state.repo = repo
    app.state.seeder = seeder

    async def on_event(routing_key: str, data: dict) -> None:
        if routing_key.startswith(("item.created", "wear.recorded")):
            await seeder.update_for_item(data["item_id"])

    conn = await EventConsumer.subscribe(
        "graph-service.queue",
        ["item.created", "wear.recorded"],
        on_event,
    )
    app.state.consumer_conn = conn
    logger.info("Graph service ready")
    yield
    await conn.close()
    await repo.close()


app = FastAPI(title="Cirvanna Graph Service", version="3.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.middleware("http")(correlation_middleware)
setup_telemetry(app, SERVICE_NAME)
Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app, endpoint="/metrics", include_in_schema=False)


@app.exception_handler(CirvannaError)
async def _err(request: Request, exc: CirvannaError) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=exc.to_dict())


def get_repo() -> GraphRepository:
    return app.state.repo


Repo = Annotated[GraphRepository, Depends(get_repo)]
CurrentUser = Annotated[str, Depends(current_user)]


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok", "service": SERVICE_NAME}


@app.get("/compatible/{item_id}")
async def compatible(
    item_id: str,
    repo: Repo,
    user: CurrentUser,
    min_confidence: float = Query(DEFAULT_MIN_CONFIDENCE, ge=0.0, le=1.0),
    limit: int = Query(DEFAULT_LIMIT, ge=1, le=100),
) -> dict:
    return {"items": await repo.get_compatible(item_id, min_confidence, limit)}


@app.get("/stats")
async def stats(repo: Repo, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    return await repo.stats()


@app.post("/maintenance/decay")
async def decay(repo: Repo, user: CurrentUser, days: int = Query(7, ge=1, le=365)) -> dict:
    removed = await repo.decay_and_prune(days, EDGE_PRUNE_THRESHOLD)
    return {"removed": removed}
```

services/recommendation-service/app/imperfection_engine.py

```python
"""Imperfection engine: injects realistic noise and contradictions.

The original prototype hardcoded distributions and deterministic contradictions.
This version:
  - Uses per-dimension Gaussian noise scaled by the raw score.
  - Samples a contradiction from a weighted distribution.
  - Is seeded for reproducibility in tests.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from common.domain import RiskLevel


class ImperfectionEngine:
    def __init__(
        self,
        noise_level: float = 0.2,
        bad_prob: float = 0.2,
        avg_prob: float = 0.3,
        rng: random.Random | None = None,
        np_rng: np.random.Generator | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.noise = noise_level
        self.bad_prob = bad_prob
        self.avg_prob = avg_prob
        self._rng = rng or random.Random()
        self._np = np_rng or np.random.default_rng(seed=self._rng.randint(0, 2**31))

    def _sample_multiplier(self) -> float:
        r = self._rng.random()
        if r < self.bad_prob:
            return 0.3
        if r < self.bad_prob + self.avg_prob:
            return 0.6
        return 0.9

    def _corrupt(self, scores: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
        mult = self._sample_multiplier()
        return {
            k: float(max(0.0, min(1.0, v * mult + self._np.normal(0, self.noise))))
            for k, v in scores.items()
        }

    def _contradict(self, scores: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
        out = dict(scores)
        case = self._rng.choice(["fit_vs_color", "style_vs_occasion", "none"])
        if case == "fit_vs_color":
            out["fit"] = min(1.0, out.get("fit", 0.5) + 0.3)
            out["color"] = max(0.0, out.get("color", 0.5) - 0.4)
        elif case == "style_vs_occasion":
            out["style"] = min(1.0, out.get("style", 0.5) + 0.3)
            out["occasion"] = max(0.0, out.get("occasion", 0.5) - 0.4)
        return out

    def process(self, raw_scores: dict[str, float]) -> tuple[dict[str, float], dict[str, Any]]:
        final = self._corrupt(self._contradict(raw_scores))
        confidence = sum(final.values()) / max(len(final), 1)
        risk = (
            RiskLevel.LOW.value
            if confidence >= 0.7
            else RiskLevel.MEDIUM.value
            if confidence >= 0.4
            else RiskLevel.HIGH.value
        )
        dims = list(final)
        return final, {
            "confidence": round(confidence, 3),
            "risk_level": risk,
            "dominant_strength": max(dims, key=lambda d: final[d]),
            "dominant_weakness": min(dims, key=lambda d: final[d]),
        }
```

services/recommendation-service/app/vector_client.py

```python
"""Qdrant client wrapper for item embeddings."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from qdrant_client import AsyncQdrantClient
from qdrant_client.models import Distance, PointStruct, VectorParams

from .config import QDRANT_COLLECTION, QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VectorClient:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.client = AsyncQdrantClient(url=QDRANT_URL)
        self.collection = QDRANT_COLLECTION

    async def ensure_collection(self) -> None:
        cols = await self.client.get_collections()
        if self.collection not in [c.name for c in cols.collections]:
            await self.client.create_collection(
                self.collection,
                vectors_config=VectorParams(size=QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE, distance=Distance.COSINE),
            )
            logger.info(f"Created Qdrant collection {self.collection}")

    async def upsert(self, item_id: str, vector: list[float], payload: dict) -> None:
        await self.client.upsert(
            self.collection,
            points=[PointStruct(id=item_id, vector=vector, payload=payload)],
        )

    async def search(
        self, vector: list[float], limit: int = 10, score_threshold: float | None = None
    ) -> list[dict]:
        results = await self.client.search(
            self.collection,
            query_vector=vector,
            limit=limit,
            score_threshold=score_threshold,
        )
        return [{"id": r.id, "score": r.score, "payload": r.payload} for r in results]

    async def close(self) -> None:
        await self.client.close()
```

services/recommendation-service/app/scoring.py

```python
"""Pure scoring functions for outfit compatibility."""
from __future__ import annotations

from common.domain import ColorVector


def color_score(a: dict, b: dict) -> float:
    sa, sb = a.get("surface_properties"), b.get("surface_properties")
    if not sa or not sb:
        return 0.5
    c1 = ColorVector.from_dict(sa["dominant_color"])
    c2 = ColorVector.from_dict(sb["dominant_color"])
    return 1.0 - min(1.0, c1.distance_to(c2) / 100.0)


def fit_score(a: dict, b: dict) -> float:
    ga, gb = a.get("geometry_profile"), b.get("geometry_profile")
    if not ga or not gb:
        return 0.5
    score = 0.5
    if ga["silhouette_class"] == gb["silhouette_class"]:
        score += 0.3
    v1, v2 = ga["volume_distribution"], gb["volume_distribution"]
    sim = 1.0 - sum(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(v1, v2)) / 2.0
    score += sim * 0.2
    return min(1.0, score)


def style_score(a: dict, b: dict) -> float:
    ra = set(a.get("category_constraints", {}).get("secondary_roles", []))
    rb = set(b.get("category_constraints", {}).get("secondary_roles", []))
    if not ra or not rb:
        return 0.5
    overlap = len(ra & rb) / max(len(ra | rb), 1)
    return 0.5 + overlap * 0.4


def occasion_score(a: dict, b: dict) -> float:
    aa = set(a.get("wearability_context", {}).get("activity_affinity", []))
    ab = set(b.get("wearability_context", {}).get("activity_affinity", []))
    if not aa or not ab:
        return 0.5
    return 0.5 + (len(aa & ab) / max(len(aa), len(ab))) * 0.4


def compute_outfit_scores(a: dict, b: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    return {
        "color": color_score(a, b),
        "fit": fit_score(a, b),
        "style": style_score(a, b),
        "occasion": occasion_score(a, b),
    }
```

services/recommendation-service/app/main.py

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Annotated

import httpx
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator

from common.cache import RedisCache
from common.config import settings
from common.errors import CirvannaError, UpstreamError
from common.logging_config import configure_logging
from common.security import correlation_middleware, current_user
from common.telemetry import setup_telemetry

from .config import GRAPH_SERVICE_URL, ITEM_SERVICE_URL, SERVICE_NAME, SUGGESTION_CACHE_TTL
from .imperfection_engine import ImperfectionEngine
from .scoring import compute_outfit_scores
from .vector_client import VectorClient

configure_logging(SERVICE_NAME, settings.log_level, settings.log_format)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    await RedisCache.init()
    vc = VectorClient()
    await vc.ensure_collection()
    app.state.vectors = vc
    app.state.imperfection = ImperfectionEngine()
    logger.info("Recommendation service ready")
    yield
    await vc.close()
    await RedisCache.close()


app = FastAPI(title="Cirvanna Recommendation Service", version="3.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.middleware("http")(correlation_middleware)
setup_telemetry(app, SERVICE_NAME)
Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app, endpoint="/metrics", include_in_schema=False)


@app.exception_handler(CirvannaError)
async def _err(request: Request, exc: CirvannaError) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=exc.to_dict())


CurrentUser = Annotated[str, Depends(current_user)]


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok", "service": SERVICE_NAME}


@app.get("/suggestions/{item_id}")
async def suggestions(
    item_id: str,
    user: CurrentUser,
    exploration: bool = Query(False),
    limit: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=50),
) -> dict:
    cache_key = f"rec:sugg:{item_id}:{exploration}:{limit}"
    cached = await RedisCache.get_json(cache_key)
    if cached:
        return cached

    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=8.0) as client:
            r = await client.get(
                f"{GRAPH_SERVICE_URL}/compatible/{item_id}",
                params={"min_confidence": 0.2 if exploration else 0.3, "limit": limit * 2},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            graph_items = r.json()["items"]
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        raise UpstreamError(f"Graph service error: {exc}")

    response = {
        "item_id": item_id,
        "suggestions": [
            {
                "item_id": g["id"],
                "compatibility": g["weight"],
                "confidence": g["confidence"],
                "reason": "graph_compatible",
            }
            for g in graph_items[:limit]
        ],
    }
    await RedisCache.set_json(cache_key, response, ttl=SUGGESTION_CACHE_TTL)
    return response


@app.post("/evaluate/{item1_id}/{item2_id}")
async def evaluate(item1_id: str, item2_id: str, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=8.0) as client:
            r1 = await client.get(f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items/{item1_id}")
            r2 = await client.get(f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items/{item2_id}")
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        raise UpstreamError(f"Item service error: {exc}")

    if r1.status_code != 200 or r2.status_code != 200:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Item not found")

    raw = compute_outfit_scores(r1.json(), r2.json())
    final, meta = app.state.imperfection.process(raw)
    return {"scores": final, "meta": meta}
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import random

import numpy as np
import pytest

from app.imperfection_engine import ImperfectionEngine


def test_meta_fields_present() -> None:
    engine = ImperfectionEngine(
        noise_level=0.05,
        rng=random.Random(42),
        np_rng=np.random.default_rng(42),
    )
    scores, meta = engine.process({"color": 0.8, "fit": 0.7, "style": 0.6, "occasion": 0.5})
    assert set(scores) == {"color", "fit", "style", "occasion"}
    assert {"confidence", "risk_level", "dominant_strength", "dominant_weakness"} <= meta.keys()
    assert all(0.0 <= v <= 1.0 for v in scores.values())


def test_deterministic_with_seed() -> None:
    e1 = ImperfectionEngine(rng=random.Random(1), np_rng=np.random.default_rng(1))
    e2 = ImperfectionEngine(rng=random.Random(1), np_rng=np.random.default_rng(1))
    s1, _ = e1.process({"color": 0.5, "fit": 0.5, "style": 0.5, "occasion": 0.5})
    s2, _ = e2.process({"color": 0.5, "fit": 0.5, "style": 0.5, "occasion": 0.5})
    assert s1 == s2
```

services/perception-service/app/perception.py

```python
"""CLIP-based zero-shot garment analysis (singleton model loader)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import threading
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any

import httpx
import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from transformers import CLIPModel, CLIPProcessor

from common.domain import ColorVector

from .config import CLIP_DEVICE, CLIP_MODEL

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SIL_CLASSES = ["fitted", "relaxed", "oversized", "structured", "fluid"]
TEX_CLASSES = ["smooth", "coarse", "knit", "reflective", "matte"]


class CLIPPerception:
    _instance: "CLIPPerception | None" = None
    _lock = threading.Lock()

    def __new__(cls) -> "CLIPPerception":
        if cls._instance is None:
            with cls._lock:
                if cls._instance is None:
                    cls._instance = super().__new__(cls)
                    cls._instance._init()
        return cls._instance

    def _init(self) -> None:
        device = CLIP_DEVICE
        if device == "auto":
            device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        self.device = device
        logger.info(f"Loading CLIP model {CLIP_MODEL} on {device}")
        self.model = CLIPModel.from_pretrained(CLIP_MODEL).to(self.device).eval()
        self.processor = CLIPProcessor.from_pretrained(CLIP_MODEL)
        self._sil_text = self.processor(
            text=[f"a {c} clothing item" for c in SIL_CLASSES],
            return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
        )
        self._tex_text = self.processor(
            text=[f"{c} fabric texture" for c in TEX_CLASSES],
            return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
        )
        logger.info("CLIP model ready")

    async def analyze(
        self, image_url: str, category_hint: str | None = None
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], list[float]]:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15.0) as client:
            r = await client.get(image_url)
            r.raise_for_status()
            img = Image.open(BytesIO(r.content)).convert("RGB")

        inputs = self.processor(images=img, return_tensors="pt").to(self.device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            emb = self.model.get_image_features(**inputs).cpu().numpy().flatten()

        e_t = torch.tensor(emb, device=self.device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            sil_f = self.model.get_text_features(**{k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in self._sil_text.items()})
            tex_f = self.model.get_text_features(**{k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in self._tex_text.items()})
            sil_sim = (sil_f @ e_t).softmax(dim=0)
            tex_sim = (tex_f @ e_t).softmax(dim=0)

        sil = SIL_CLASSES[int(sil_sim.argmax().item())]
        tex = TEX_CLASSES[int(tex_sim.argmax().item())]

        arr = np.asarray(img)
        avg = arr.mean(axis=(0, 1)).astype(int)
        cv = ColorVector.from_rgb(int(avg[0]), int(avg[1]), int(avg[2]))
        variance = float(np.var(arr, axis=(0, 1)).mean() / 255.0)

        gray = np.asarray(img.convert("L"))
        mag = np.log(np.abs(np.fft.fftshift(np.fft.fft2(gray))) + 1)
        pattern = float(np.mean(mag > 10)) if np.any(mag > 10) else 0.0

        geometry = {
            "silhouette_class": sil,
            "length_profile": "hip",
            "volume_distribution": [0.33, 0.34, 0.33],
            "stretch_behavior": "semi_flexible",
        }
        surface = {
            "dominant_color": cv.to_dict(),
            "color_variance": variance,
            "texture_class": tex,
            "pattern_density": pattern,
            "lighting_risk": 0.3,
        }
        return geometry, surface, emb.tolist()
```

services/perception-service/app/tasks.py

```python
"""Celery worker tasks for async image analysis."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging

from celery import Celery

from common.config import settings
from common.events import EventPublisher

from .perception import CLIPPerception

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

celery_app = Celery(
    "perception",
    broker=settings.celery_broker_url,
    backend=settings.celery_result_backend,
)
celery_app.conf.update(
    task_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    result_serializer="json",
    timezone="UTC",
    enable_utc=True,
    task_acks_late=True,
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,
    task_time_limit=300,
    task_soft_time_limit=240,
)


@celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=30, name="perception.analyze")
def analyze_image(self, item_id: str, image_url: str, category_hint: str | None = None) -> dict:
    try:
        model = CLIPPerception()
        geometry, surface, embedding = asyncio.run(model.analyze(image_url, category_hint))

        async def _emit() -> None:
            await EventPublisher.init()
            await EventPublisher.publish(
                "perception.completed",
                {
                    "item_id": item_id,
                    "geometry": geometry,
                    "surface": surface,
                    "embedding": embedding,
                },
            )
            await EventPublisher.close()

        asyncio.run(_emit())
        logger.info(f"Perception completed for {item_id}")
        return {"item_id": item_id, "status": "done"}
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception(f"Perception failed for {item_id}")
        raise self.retry(exc=exc)
```

```python
"""Unit tests for perception (mock heavy model loading)."""
from __future__ import annotations

from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import numpy as np
import pytest
from PIL import Image

from app import perception


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_analyze_returns_expected_keys(monkeypatch) -> None:
    fake_img = Image.new("RGB", (64, 64), color=(120, 80, 200))
    fake_bytes = MagicMock()
    fake_bytes.content = b""

    # Skip actual model loading
    monkeypatch.setattr(perception, "CLIPPerception", lambda: None)

    # This is a structural smoke test — full inference tests run in integration
    assert hasattr(perception, "SIL_CLASSES")
    assert hasattr(perception, "TEX_CLASSES")
    assert len(perception.SIL_CLASSES) == 5
    assert len(perception.TEX_CLASSES) == 5
```

services/sync-service/app/db.py

```python
"""Async engine for the sync service's persistent queue."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncEngine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
    create_async_engine,
)

from common.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_engine: AsyncEngine | None = None
_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None


def get_engine() -> AsyncEngine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        _engine = create_async_engine(
            settings.database_url, pool_pre_ping=True, pool_size=10, max_overflow=5
        )
    return _engine


def get_factory() -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
    global _factory
    if _factory is None:
        _factory = async_sessionmaker(get_engine(), class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)
    return _factory


async def get_session() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    async with get_factory()() as s:
        try:
            yield s
        except Exception:
            await s.rollback()
            raise


async def dispose() -> None:
    global _engine, _factory
    if _engine is not None:
        await _engine.dispose()
        _engine = None
        _factory = None
```

```python
"""Persistent offline event queue."""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import DateTime, Index, Integer, String, Text, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class OfflineEvent(Base):
    __tablename__ = "offline_events"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True, nullable=False)
    event_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    payload: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="pending", index=True, nullable=False)
    retry_count: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
    last_error: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[dt.datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False
    )
    updated_at: Mapped[dt.datetime] = mapped_column(
        DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False
    )

    __table_args__ = (Index("ix_offline_user_status", "user_id", "status"),)
```

services/sync-service/app/offline_queue.py

```python
"""Persistent offline queue with replay + retry semantics."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from .config import BATCH_SIZE, MAX_RETRIES
from .models import OfflineEvent

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

Handler = Callable[[str, str, dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[None]]


class OfflineQueue:
    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def enqueue(self, user_id: str, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        ev = OfflineEvent(user_id=user_id, event_type=event_type, payload=payload)
        self.session.add(ev)
        await self.session.flush()
        return ev.id

    async def pending(self, user_id: str, limit: int = BATCH_SIZE) -> list[OfflineEvent]:
        stmt = (
            select(OfflineEvent)
            .where(OfflineEvent.user_id == user_id, OfflineEvent.status == "pending")
            .order_by(OfflineEvent.created_at)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return list((await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())

    async def mark_success(self, event_id: int) -> None:
        await self.session.execute(
            update(OfflineEvent)
            .where(OfflineEvent.id == event_id)
            .values(status="success")
        )
        await self.session.flush()

    async def mark_failure(self, event_id: int, error: str) -> None:
        stmt = select(OfflineEvent).where(OfflineEvent.id == event_id)
        ev = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
        if ev is None:
            return
        ev.retry_count += 1
        ev.last_error = error[:1000]
        if ev.retry_count >= MAX_RETRIES:
            ev.status = "dead"
        await self.session.flush()

    async def replay(self, user_id: str, handler: Handler) -> dict[str, int]:
        events = await self.pending(user_id)
        stats = {"attempted": len(events), "succeeded": 0, "failed": 0}
        for ev in events:
            try:
                await handler(ev.user_id, ev.event_type, ev.payload)
                await self.mark_success(ev.id)
                stats["succeeded"] += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning(f"Replay failed for event {ev.id}: {exc}")
                await self.mark_failure(ev.id, str(exc))
                stats["failed"] += 1
        await self.session.commit()
        return stats

    async def stats(self, user_id: str) -> dict[str, int]:
        from sqlalchemy import func as sqlfunc

        stmt = (
            select(OfflineEvent.status, sqlfunc.count(OfflineEvent.id))
            .where(OfflineEvent.user_id == user_id)
            .group_by(OfflineEvent.status)
        )
        rows = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).all()
        return {status: count for status, count in rows}
```

services/sync-service/app/conflict_resolver.py

```python
"""Conflict resolution between local and remote WardrobeObject snapshots."""
from __future__ import annotations

from common.domain import WardrobeObject


def resolve(local: WardrobeObject, remote: WardrobeObject) -> WardrobeObject:
    """Last-write-wins with confidence/regret merging.

    - The newer snapshot wins for scalar fields.
    - Wear counters take the maximum to avoid losing data.
    - Per-dimension confidence takes the maximum.
    - Regret signals union with max strength.
    """
    winner = remote if remote.last_updated > local.last_updated else local
    loser = local if winner is remote else remote

    if winner.total_wears < loser.total_wears:
        winner.total_wears = loser.total_wears
        winner.successful_wears = loser.successful_wears
        winner.usage_history = loser.usage_history

    for field in (
        "geometry_confidence",
        "surface_confidence",
        "category_confidence",
        "context_confidence",
    ):
        setattr(
            winner.confidence_envelope,
            field,
            max(
                getattr(local.confidence_envelope, field),
                getattr(remote.confidence_envelope, field),
            ),
        )

    for k, tv in remote.regret_signals.implicit.items():
        if k in winner.regret_signals.implicit:
            winner.regret_signals.implicit[k].current = max(
                winner.regret_signals.implicit[k].current, tv.current
            )
        else:
            winner.regret_signals.implicit[k] = tv

    return winner
```

services/sync-service/app/main.py

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Annotated

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from common.config import settings
from common.errors import CirvannaError, UpstreamError
from common.logging_config import configure_logging
from common.security import correlation_middleware, current_user
from common.telemetry import setup_telemetry

from .config import ITEM_SERVICE_URL, SERVICE_NAME
from .db import dispose, get_engine, get_session
from .models import Base
from .offline_queue import OfflineQueue

configure_logging(SERVICE_NAME, settings.log_level, settings.log_format)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    async with get_engine().begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    logger.info("Sync service ready")
    yield
    await dispose()


app = FastAPI(title="Cirvanna Sync Service", version="3.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.middleware("http")(correlation_middleware)
setup_telemetry(app, SERVICE_NAME)
Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app, endpoint="/metrics", include_in_schema=False)


@app.exception_handler(CirvannaError)
async def _err(request: Request, exc: CirvannaError) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=exc.to_dict())


class EventPayload(BaseModel):
    event_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=32)
    payload: dict


def get_queue(session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)]) -> OfflineQueue:
    return OfflineQueue(session)


Queue = Annotated[OfflineQueue, Depends(get_queue)]
CurrentUser = Annotated[str, Depends(current_user)]


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok", "service": SERVICE_NAME}


@app.post("/offline/{user_id}/event", status_code=202)
async def enqueue(user_id: str, ev: EventPayload, queue: Queue, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    eid = await queue.enqueue(user_id, ev.event_type, ev.payload)
    await queue.session.commit()
    return {"event_id": eid, "status": "queued"}


@app.get("/offline/{user_id}/stats")
async def stats(user_id: str, queue: Queue, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    return await queue.stats(user_id)


@app.post("/replay/{user_id}")
async def replay(user_id: str, queue: Queue, user: CurrentUser) -> dict:
    async def handler(uid: str, etype: str, payload: dict) -> None:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as c:
            if etype == "wear_event":
                r = await c.post(
                    f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items/{payload['item_id']}/wear",
                    json={
                        "accepted": payload["accepted"],
                        "duration_minutes": payload["duration_minutes"],
                        "event_type": payload.get("event_type", "wear"),
                    },
                )
            elif etype == "add_item":
                r = await c.post(f"{ITEM_SERVICE_URL}/items", json=payload)
            else:
                logger.warning(f"Unknown offline event type: {etype}")
                return
            r.raise_for_status()

    return await queue.replay(user_id, handler)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
import pytest_asyncio
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

from app.models import Base
from app.offline_queue import OfflineQueue


@pytest_asyncio.fixture
async def session() -> AsyncSession:
    engine = create_async_engine("sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:")
    async with engine.begin() as c:
        await c.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    factory = async_sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)
    async with factory() as s:
        yield s
    await engine.dispose()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_enqueue_and_replay(session: AsyncSession) -> None:
    q = OfflineQueue(session)
    await q.enqueue("u1", "wear_event", {"item_id": "1", "accepted": True, "duration_minutes": 60})
    await session.commit()
    assert len(await q.pending("u1")) == 1

    calls: list = []

    async def handler(uid, etype, payload):
        calls.append((uid, etype, payload))

    stats = await q.replay("u1", handler)
    assert stats == {"attempted": 1, "succeeded": 1, "failed": 0}
    assert calls[0][0] == "u1"
    assert len(await q.pending("u1")) == 0
```

```python
from common.domain import IngestionMethod, PrimaryCategory, WardrobeObject
```

services/catalog-importer/importer.py

```python
"""Standalone CLI to batch-import garment catalogs (CSV or JSON)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import csv
import json
import logging
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import click
import httpx

from common.domain import ColorVector

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger("catalog-importer")


def _row_to_item(row: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    category = row.get("category", "top").strip().lower()
    try:
        color = ColorVector.from_hex(row.get("color", "#808080")).to_dict()
    except Exception:
        color = {"l": 50.0, "a": 0.0, "b": 0.0}

    return {
        "owner_id": row.get("owner_id", "system"),
        "ingestion_method": "catalog_import",
        "primary_category": category,
        "bootstrap_confidence": 0.1,
        "geometry_data": {
            "silhouette_class": row.get("silhouette", "relaxed").strip().lower(),
            "length_profile": row.get("length", "hip").strip(),
            "volume_distribution": [0.33, 0.34, 0.33],
            "stretch_behavior": row.get("stretch", "semi_flexible").strip(),
        },
        "surface_data": {
            "dominant_color": color,
            "color_variance": 0.5,
            "texture_class": row.get("texture", "smooth").strip().lower(),
            "pattern_density": 0.0,
            "lighting_risk": 0.5,
        },
        "catalog_metadata": dict(row),
    }


async def _send_batch(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, url: str, batch: list[dict], token: str
) -> int:
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    ok = 0
    for item in batch:
        try:
            r = await client.post(f"{url}/items", json=item, headers=headers, timeout=30.0)
            r.raise_for_status()
            ok += 1
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            log.error(f"Failed to import item: {exc}")
    return ok


async def _import_csv(url: str, path: Path, chunk: int, token: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    total = ok = 0
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            reader = csv.DictReader(f)
            batch: list[dict] = []
            for row in reader:
                total += 1
                batch.append(_row_to_item(row))
                if len(batch) >= chunk:
                    ok += await _send_batch(client, url, batch, token)
                    batch = []
                    log.info(f"Progress: {total} rows processed")
            if batch:
                ok += await _send_batch(client, url, batch, token)
    return total, ok


async def _import_json(url: str, path: Path, chunk: int, token: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    rows = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("items", [])
    total = len(rows)
    ok = 0
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        for i in range(0, total, chunk):
            batch = [_row_to_item(r) for r in rows[i : i + chunk]]
            ok += await _send_batch(client, url, batch, token)
            log.info(f"Progress: {min(i + chunk, total)}/{total}")
    return total, ok


@click.command()
@click.option("--file", "file_path", required=True, type=click.Path(exists=True, path_type=Path))
@click.option("--url", default="http://localhost:8080", help="API gateway base URL")
@click.option("--chunk", default=100, type=int, help="Batch size")
@click.option("--token", required=True, help="JWT bearer token")
def cli(file_path: Path, url: str, chunk: int, token: str) -> None:
    """Import a catalog from CSV or JSON."""
    if file_path.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
        coro = _import_csv(url, file_path, chunk, token)
    elif file_path.suffix.lower() == ".json":
        coro = _import_json(url, file_path, chunk, token)
    else:
        click.echo(f"Unsupported file type: {file_path.suffix}", err=True)
        sys.exit(1)

    total, ok = asyncio.run(coro)
    click.echo(f"Imported {ok}/{total} items successfully")
    if ok != total:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cli()
```

services/api-gateway/app/rate_limiter.py

```python
"""Per-endpoint + per-IP rate limiter backed by Redis."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from fastapi import Request

from common.cache import RedisCache
from common.errors import RateLimitError

from .config import DEFAULT_LIMIT, ENDPOINT_LIMITS

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    """Respect X-Forwarded-For when behind a proxy."""
    xff = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")
    if xff:
        return xff.split(",")[0].strip()
    return request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"


class EndpointRateLimiter:
    @staticmethod
    async def check(request: Request) -> None:
        path = request.url.path
        limit, window = DEFAULT_LIMIT
        for prefix, cfg in ENDPOINT_LIMITS.items():
            if path.startswith(prefix):
                limit, window = cfg
                break

        ip = _client_ip(request)
        key = f"rl:{path}:{ip}"
        count = await RedisCache.incr(key, ttl=window)
        if count > limit:
            logger.warning(f"Rate limit hit path={path} ip={ip} count={count}")
            raise RateLimitError(
                f"Rate limit exceeded for {path}",
                details={"limit": limit, "window_seconds": window, "count": count},
            )
```

services/api-gateway/app/circuit_breaker.py

```python
"""Circuit breaker with gradual (sliding-scale) traffic restoration."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import random
import threading
import time
from enum import Enum

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class State(str, Enum):
    CLOSED = "closed"
    OPEN = "open"
    HALF_OPEN = "half_open"


class SlidingCircuitBreaker:
    """Recovery ramp: 10% → 25% → 50% → 100% on consecutive successes."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        failure_threshold: int = 5,
        recovery_timeout: float = 60.0,
        initial_ratio: float = 0.1,
        ramp_factor: float = 2.5,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.threshold = failure_threshold
        self.recovery_timeout = recovery_timeout
        self.initial_ratio = initial_ratio
        self.ramp_factor = ramp_factor

        self._state = State.CLOSED
        self._failures = 0
        self._last_failure_ts = 0.0
        self._traffic_ratio = 1.0
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    @property
    def state(self) -> State:
        return self._state

    @property
    def traffic_ratio(self) -> float:
        return self._traffic_ratio

    def allow(self) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if self._state is State.CLOSED:
                return True
            if self._state is State.OPEN:
                if time.monotonic() - self._last_failure_ts >= self.recovery_timeout:
                    self._state = State.HALF_OPEN
                    self._traffic_ratio = self.initial_ratio
                    logger.info(f"CB {self.name}: OPEN → HALF_OPEN (ratio={self._traffic_ratio})")
                    return random.random() < self._traffic_ratio
                return False
            # HALF_OPEN
            return random.random() < self._traffic_ratio

    def record(self, success: bool) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if success:
                self._failures = 0
                if self._state is State.HALF_OPEN:
                    self._traffic_ratio = min(1.0, self._traffic_ratio * self.ramp_factor)
                    if self._traffic_ratio >= 1.0:
                        self._state = State.CLOSED
                        logger.info(f"CB {self.name}: HALF_OPEN → CLOSED")
            else:
                self._failures += 1
                if self._state is State.HALF_OPEN:
                    self._state = State.OPEN
                    self._last_failure_ts = time.monotonic()
                    self._traffic_ratio = self.initial_ratio
                    logger.warning(f"CB {self.name}: HALF_OPEN → OPEN")
                elif self._failures >= self.threshold:
                    self._state = State.OPEN
                    self._last_failure_ts = time.monotonic()
                    logger.warning(f"CB {self.name}: CLOSED → OPEN after {self._failures} failures")

    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "state": self._state.value,
            "failures": self._failures,
            "traffic_ratio": self._traffic_ratio,
        }
```

    app.state.breakers = {
        name: SlidingCircuitBreaker(
            name=name,
            failure_threshold=CB_FAILURE_THRESHOLD,

    }

    await app.state.client.aclose()
    await RedisCache.close()
